articles.title: WRDO: Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization in Aligned Language Models
articles.abstract: Aligned large language models are trained to comply with benign requests while refusing harmful ones. However, recent work shows that this refusal behavior is fragile and can often be disrupted by simple activation- or weight-space interventions. In particular, refusal has been shown to be largely mediated by a single residual-stream direction, typically computed as a difference-of-means vector between harmful and harmless prompts. However, this standard construction aggregates heterogeneous harmful prompts into one uniform average, potentially conflating distinct refusal-related phenomena. In this work, we study whether refusal interventions can be strengthened by learning how to combine prompt-specific refusal directions. We propose Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization (WRDO), a procedure that constructs a composite refusal direction from a bank of per-prompt directions using learned aggregation weights. This approach allows different harmful prompts to contribute unequally to the final intervention direction. We evaluate WRDO against prior single-direction methods on three open-weight language models using three guard judges and HarmBench as an external evaluator. We further measure the effect of the intervention on general model capability through standard utility benchmarks. Finally, we investigate a defense-oriented setting in which the same optimization machinery is used in reverse to restore refusal behavior in an abliterated model checkpoint. Our results show that weighted aggregation provides a more effective and flexible mechanism for manipulating refusal representations.
articles.titleCn: 对齐语言模型中的加权拒绝方向优化（WRDO）
articles.abstractCn: 对齐的大型语言模型被训练以遵循良性请求，同时拒绝有害请求。然而，最近的研究表明，这种拒绝行为是脆弱的，并且经常可以通过简单的激活空间或权重空间干预来破坏。特别是，拒绝已被证明主要是由单个残差流方向介导的，通常计算为有害和无害提示之间的均值差向量。然而，这种标准构造将异构的有害提示聚合为一个统一的平均值，可能会混淆不同的与拒绝相关的现象。在这项工作中，我们研究是否可以通过学习如何组合特定提示的拒绝方向来加强拒绝干预。我们提出了加权拒绝方向优化（WRDO），这是一种使用学习到的聚合权重从每个提示方向库构建复合拒绝方向的程序。这种方法允许不同的有害提示对最终干预方向做出不等同的贡献。我们在三个开放权重语言模型上使用三个守门法官，并使用HarmBench作为外部评估器，评估WRDO与先前的单方向方法。我们进一步通过标准效用基准测量干预对模型一般能力的影响。最后，我们研究了一个防御性设置，其中相同的优化机制被反向使用，以恢复被破坏模型检查点的拒绝行为。我们的结果表明，加权聚合为操纵拒绝表示提供了一种更有效和灵活的机制。

articles.title: PACE: Periodic and Channel-Aligned Encoding of Four-Bit Recurrent States
articles.abstract: Linear-attention language models keep their context in a recurrent state of fixed size, where an inference system stores one copy of this state for every sequence it decodes at the same time. Storing the state at lower precision therefore lets more sequences share an accelerator. Existing state quantizers round the state after every generated token and report that four bits lose accuracy unless the bit width is raised or the model is fine-tuned.\par We introduce PACE, a post-hoc four-bit state quantizer. PACE rounds the state only once every few generated tokens, as chunked kernels already do once per chunk during prefill, and keeps the tokens generated in between in a small buffer. Rounding less often reduces the error that accumulates in the state. Additionally, we find that the large entries of the gated-delta state gather in columns, because some channels of the update written at each token remain large across many tokens. PACE therefore shares each quantization scale within one column. It also keeps the heads that retain rounding error longest at eight bits. On four hybrid models from 4B to 35B parameters, PACE with mixed four- and eight-bit heads is competitive with eight-bit DAMP on the three larger models at about two thirds of its memory, PACE with four-bit heads throughout scores higher than Q-Mamba at equal memory, and rounding every few tokens preserves the decoding speedup of the buffer.
articles.titleCn: PACE：四比特循环状态的周期性及信道对齐编码
articles.abstractCn: 线性注意力语言模型将其上下文保存在固定大小的循环状态中，推理系统为同时解码的每个序列存储该状态的一个副本。因此，以较低精度存储状态可以让更多序列共享加速器。现有的状态量化器在生成每个标记后对状态进行舍入，并报告除非增加位宽或对模型进行微调，否则四位会损失精度。\par 我们介绍了PACE，一种后处理四比特状态量化器。PACE每隔几个生成的标记只舍入一次状态，就像分块内核在prefill期间每个块舍入一次一样，并将中间生成的标记保存在一个小缓冲区中。较少舍入次数减少了状态中累积的错误。此外，我们发现门控增量状态的大型条目会聚集在列中，因为每次标记写入的更新的一些通道在许多标记之间保持较大。因此，PACE在每一列内共享每个量化比例。它还保持保留舍入误差最长的头部为八比特。在参数从4B到35B的四种混合模型上，PACE混合四比特和八比特头在三个较大模型上与八比特DAMP具有竞争力，大约是其内存的三分之二；PACE全程使用四比特头在相同内存下得分高于Q-Mamba；每隔几个标记进行舍入保留了缓冲区的解码加速。

articles.title: RCSD: Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Domain-Specific Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by employing a compact draft model to propose candidate tokens that are verified in parallel by a target model. Conventional training relies on soft-label distillation, which forces the draft model to mimic the target's full output distribution, including high-entropy regions that degrade acceptance rates and increase early rejection risk. We propose RCSD (Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Speculative Decoding), a training framework that aligns draft model optimization with the system-level objective of maximizing acceptance length. RCSD leverages naturally occurring accepted and rejected sequences during speculative inference to construct implicit preference pairs, with masked loss to avoid penalizing target-aligned tokens. Evaluated across multiple benchmarks, RCSD improves average acceptance length by 35% over HASS and achieves 1.35x faster end-to-end inference than HASS on practical workloads, without compromising generation quality.
articles.titleCn: RCSD：面向特定领域的推测解码的强化与持续学习
articles.abstractCn: 推测解码通过采用紧凑的草稿模型来提出候选词元，并由目标模型并行验证，从而加速大型语言模型的推理。传统训练依赖于软标签蒸馏，迫使草稿模型模仿目标模型的完整输出分布，包括高熵区域，这会降低接受率并增加早期拒绝风险。我们提出了RCSD（用于推测解码的强化学习和持续学习）训练框架，该框架使草稿模型优化与最大化接受长度的系统级目标保持一致。RCSD利用推测解码过程中自然产生的接受和拒绝序列来构建隐式偏好对，并使用掩码损失来避免惩罚与目标一致的词元。在多个基准测试中评估表明，RCSD比HASS平均接受长度提高了35%，在实际工作负载上比HASS的端到端推理速度提高了1.35倍，同时未影响生成质量。

articles.title: pplx-embed-v2-late Technical Report
articles.abstract: In this report, we introduce pplx-embed-v2-late, a pair of 0.6B and 9B multilingual and multimodal late-interaction models. Both models achieve state-of-the-art results within their respective size classes across a range of text, image, and visual document retrieval benchmarks. On visual document retrieval tasks, pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b is competitive with models several times larger than itself. The models are trained via representation distillation from an 18B teacher. Consequently, they share an embedding space that supports asymmetric deployment: documents can be indexed with the 9B model and queried with the low-latency 0.6B model. Both models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/perplexity-ai/pplx-embed-v2.
articles.titleCn: pplx-embed-v2-late 技术报告
articles.abstractCn: 在本报告中，我们介绍了pplx-embed-v2-late，这是一对0.6B和9B的多语言和多模态延迟交互模型。这两个模型在其各自规模类别中，在一系列文本、图像和视觉文档检索基准测试中均取得了最先进的结果。在视觉文档检索任务中，pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b与比自身大几倍的模型具有竞争力。这些模型通过从18B的教师模型进行表征蒸馏进行训练。因此，它们共享一个嵌入空间，支持非对称部署：文档可以使用9B模型进行索引，并使用低延迟的0.6B模型进行查询。这两个模型都可以在https://huggingface.co/collections/perplexity-ai/pplx-embed-v2上获得。

articles.title: Beyond the Vote: When Do LLMs Add Value to Retrieval-Based Tabular Classification?
articles.abstract: Retrieval-based in-context learning (ICL) enables large language models (LLMs) to predict tabular labels from similar examples, but it remains unclear whether LLM inference improves on direct voting over those same examples. We address this question by comparing four general-purpose LLMs with distance-weighted nearest-neighbor voting (Distance-KNN) using identical retrieved neighbors across 19 tabular classification datasets. With the number of demonstrations fixed, enlarging the retrieval candidate pool improves accuracy for all predictors, yet Distance-KNN achieves the highest mean accuracy at every pool size. More detailed analyses reveal that LLM gains are concentrated where retrieved neighbors exhibit low label consensus and vary across models. These gains further depend on the average feature-space distance to the test query: under low label consensus, some LLMs outperform Distance-KNN in close and intermediate neighborhoods, but all fall behind on average in the most distant group. Complementary experiments on the number of demonstrations, prompt formulation, retrieval representation, and label-balanced demonstration selection largely preserve the overall findings. These results characterize when LLM inference adds predictive value beyond distance-weighted voting in retrieval-based tabular ICL.
articles.titleCn: 超越投票：当大型语言模型为基于检索的表格分类增加价值时
articles.abstractCn: 基于检索的上下文学习（ICL）使大型语言模型（LLM）能够从相似示例中预测表格标签，但尚不清楚LLM推理是否比直接在这些相同示例上的投票有所改进。我们通过使用相同的检索邻居，在19个表格分类数据集上将四个通用大型语言模型与距离加权最近邻投票（Distance-KNN）进行比较，以解决这个问题。在演示次数固定的情况下，扩大检索候选池可以提高所有预测器的准确性，但Distance-KNN在每种池大小下都实现了最高的平均准确性。更详细的分析表明，LLM的收益集中在检索邻居标签一致性较低的地方，并且在不同模型之间存在差异。这些收益进一步取决于测试查询到特征空间平均距离：在标签一致性较低的情况下，某些LLM在邻近和中等距离邻域中优于Distance-KNN，但在最远距离组中平均表现均落后。关于演示次数、提示构建、检索表示和标签平衡演示选择的补充实验在很大程度上保留了总体发现。这些结果描述了LLM推理何时在基于检索的表格ICL中为距离加权投票之外的预测增加了价值。

articles.title: Mitigating Query Shortcuts in Chain-of-Thought with Context-Aware Decoding
articles.abstract: While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting improves the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), recent studies have shown that final answers do not always depend on the generated rationales. In particular, LLMs may rely on query-specific shortcuts rather than the information provided by their reasoning steps. In this paper, we investigate whether context-aware decoding (CAD), an existing contrastive decoding method, can mitigate such shortcut behavior when applied to CoT reasoning. We study this application as Rationale Contrastive Decoding (RCD), which contrasts the next-token distributions conditioned on the query with and without its rationale, amplifying tokens whose likelihood increases due to the rationale. We provide a theoretical interpretation of this decoding rule via a KL-regularized reward-maximization objective. Experiments across five reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RCD improves answer accuracy over standard CoT. Furthermore, intervention analyses using ground-truth and random rationales reveal that RCD increases the behavioral dependence of final answers on the rationale content. Our findings suggest that contrastive decoding offers a simple, training-free approach to mitigating query shortcuts.
articles.titleCn: 在思维链中通过上下文感知解码减轻查询捷径
articles.abstractCn: 虽然思维链（CoT）提示可以提高大型语言模型（LLM）的推理性能，但最近的研究表明，最终答案并不总是依赖于生成的推理过程。特别是，LLM可能依赖于查询特定的捷径，而不是推理步骤提供的信息。在本文中，我们研究了现有的对比解码方法上下文感知解码（CAD）在应用于CoT推理时是否能够缓解这种捷径行为。我们将这一应用研究为推理对比解码（RCD），该方法对比查询在有和没有其推理过程的情况下生成的下一个词分布，放大因推理过程而增加可能性的词。我们通过KL正则化的奖励最大化目标为这种解码规则提供了理论解释。在五个推理基准上的实验表明，RCD比标准CoT提高了答案的准确性。此外，使用真实和随机推理过程的干预分析揭示，RCD增加了最终答案对推理内容的行为依赖性。我们的研究结果表明，对比解码提供了一种简单、无需训练的方法来缓解查询捷径。

articles.title: Keeping Time vs. Understanding Time: Neither Alone Explains Temporal Reasoning in LLMs
articles.abstract: Temporal reasoning is widely assumed to decompose into two modes: temporal arithmetic (date and time calculations), and temporal semantics (understanding temporal and causal relations). This dichotomy shapes how benchmarks are designed, how models are trained, and how progress is measured, yet its empirical validity has never been directly tested. We provide two lines of evidence that challenge it. First, we test whether tasks labelled as arithmetic or semantic by the benchmarks support transferable gains within their purported mode. Finetuning on these subsets yields predominantly dataset-specific gains ($+6.8$ to $+23.1$ percentage points), while transfer to a different dataset in the same mode ranges from $-3.2$ to $+1.1$ percentage points. Across the two benchmark families used in the transfer analysis, this pattern provides little evidence of coherent, transferable temporal abilities. Second, using cognitive-demand-based model evaluation, we examine which capabilities actually drive performance on these benchmarks. We find that quantitative and logical reasoning, the assumed proxies for temporal arithmetic and temporal semantics, are not the primary drivers; knowledge is. Together, these findings show that current temporal reasoning benchmarks do not cleanly realise the arithmetic-semantics distinction and instead largely reward models for remembering how time typically works.
articles.titleCn: 计时与理解时间：两者均无法解释大型语言模型中的时间推理
articles.abstractCn: 时序推理通常被认为可以分解为两种模式：时序算术（日期和时间计算）与时序语义（理解时序和因果关系）。这种二分法影响了基准测试的设计、模型的训练以及进展的衡量方式，但其经验有效性从未得到直接验证。我们提供了两条证据来挑战这一观点。首先，我们测试了被基准测试标记为算术或语义的任务是否在其声称的模式内支持可迁移的增益。在这些子集上进行微调主要产生了数据集特定的增益（+6.8至+23.1个百分点），而在同一模式下的不同数据集上的迁移范围从-3.2至+1.1个百分点。在迁移分析中使用的两个基准测试系列中，这种模式几乎没有证据表明存在连贯、可迁移的时序能力。其次，我们使用基于认知需求模型评估方法，检查了哪些能力实际上驱动了在这些基准测试上的表现。我们发现，定量和逻辑推理——被视为时序算术和时序语义的代理指标——并不是主要驱动因素；知识才是。综合这些发现表明，当前的时序推理基准测试并没有清晰地实现算术-语义的区分，反而很大程度上奖励了模型记住时间通常是如何运作的能力。

articles.title: A Strong MoE Is All You Need for Process Supervision
articles.abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) provide fine-grained supervision for multi-step reasoning, yet obtaining reliable process labels remains a central bottleneck. Existing approaches typically rely on human annotation, rollout-based estimation, or auxiliary verification. In this work, we explore a different source of process supervision natively exposed by Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models: expert routing. We show that simple routing statistics provide an intrinsic process-confidence signal that is competitive with conventional output-logit confidence. Building on this observation, we construct routing confidence by combining overall routing mass, head routing mass, and within-step routing variation, and introduce RoCo-Rethink, which identifies the least confident reasoning step and selectively regenerates the subsequent trajectory. We further introduce RoCo-PRM, which uses a strong MoE to automatically annotate reasoning trajectories with routing-derived step scores and distills them into a standalone PRM. Across multiple MoE architectures and diverse reasoning tasks, both RoCo-Rethink and RoCo-PRM consistently outperform strong baselines, while RoCo-PRM transfers effectively across both model architectures and tasks. Our findings suggest that expert routing is more than a computational dispatch mechanism: it provides an architecture-native source of process supervision for reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 一个强大的MoE足以满足过程监督需求
articles.abstractCn: 过程奖励模型（PRMs）为多步推理提供了细粒度的监督，然而获取可靠的过程标签仍然是一个核心瓶颈。现有方法通常依赖于人工标注、基于回滚的估计或辅助验证。在这项工作中，我们探索了专家混合（MoE）模型原生暴露的过程监督来源：专家路由。我们证明简单的路由统计提供了内在的过程置信度信号，其竞争力与传统输出逻辑置信度相当。基于这一观察，我们通过结合整体路由质量、头部路由质量和步骤内路由变化来构建路由置信度，并引入了RoCo-Rethink，该模型识别最不自信的推理步骤并选择性地重新生成后续轨迹。我们进一步引入了RoCo-PRM，该模型使用强大的MoE自动标注推理轨迹，并使用路由衍生的步骤分数进行蒸馏，最终形成独立的PRM。在多种MoE架构和多样化的推理任务中，RoCo-Rethink和RoCo-PRM均持续优于强基线，而RoCo-PRM在模型架构和任务之间均能有效迁移。我们的研究表明，专家路由不仅是计算调度机制，它还为推理提供了架构原生的过程监督来源。

articles.title: TenetBench: A Clause-Anchored Russian Corpus for Evaluating Language Models against Professional Codes of Ethics
articles.abstract: Codes of professional ethics guide and restrict specialists, who increasingly work with assistants built on large language models. Such an assistant can breach the user's code, or help the user breach it, without the user noticing. Evaluations reporting broad categories of harm cannot show how often this happens or which provision is breached. TenetBench pairs 3,433 requests conflicting with clauses of fifteen Russian-language professional codes with benign twins that differ only in the legitimacy of what is asked. An automated pipeline generates the tasks from the text of a code, so the corpus grows with every code added and a provision yields new tasks on every run. It also produced tasks and human-validated verdicts from two English codes of other jurisdictions. In human validation of the frozen pipeline, specialists rated 0.995 of the conflicting tasks plausible, and the model judge agreed with the adjudicated label at Gwet's AC1 of at least 0.894 on 1,860 elements. We evaluated fourteen model and reasoning-mode combinations on whether they produce the conflicting text, decline or warn. Eleven of the fourteen produce conflicting content on most such requests, mostly without a warning, and nearly three warnings in four accompany conflicting content. The models that conform more do so by declining while still serving the legitimate twin, and enabling reasoning halved the refusals of two models. We hope the dataset and pipeline will help evaluate how language models observe professional norms and let diagnostic datasets be built for particular professions and organisations.

articles.titleCn: TenetBench：一个用于评估语言模型与专业伦理规范对比的条款锚定俄语语料库
articles.abstractCn: 专业伦理规范指导并约束专业人士，而专业人士越来越多地与基于大型语言模型构建的助手合作。此类助手可能在用户不知情的情况下违反用户的伦理规范，或帮助用户违反其规范。报告广泛类别危害的评估无法揭示这种情况发生的频率或违反了哪项规定。TenetBench将3,433个与十五个俄语专业规范条款相冲突的请求与仅请求合法性不同的良性孪生请求配对。自动化流程从规范文本中生成任务，因此随着每添加一个规范，语料库就会增长，并且每次运行都会为每项规定生成新的任务。它还从其他司法管辖区的两个英语规范中生成了任务和人工验证的裁决。在人工验证冻结的流程中，专业人士评定了0.995的冲突任务为合理，模型法官在1,860个元素上以Gwet的AC1至少为0.894的置信度同意裁决标签。我们评估了十四种模型和推理模式组合，以判断它们是否产生冲突文本、拒绝或发出警告。十四种中的十一种在大多数此类请求上产生冲突内容，且大多不发出警告，四分之三的冲突内容伴随着警告。更符合规范的模型通过拒绝合法的孪生请求来实现，而启用推理则使两个模型的拒绝率减半。我们希望该数据集和流程能帮助评估语言模型如何遵守专业规范，并让特定专业和组织能够构建诊断数据集。

articles.title: OmniSimulator: Aligning Small Language Models for Authentic Heterogeneous Behavior Modeling
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great potential as general-purpose user simulators for interactive systems. Prior studies have demonstrated that training on high-quality data can substantially improve model reasoning and downstream task performance. However, the upper bound of user simulation is still constrained by the model's reasoning paradigm: native chain-of-thought often degenerates into shallow pattern matching and fails to adequately model the behavioral factors underlying real user decisions. In this paper, we propose OmniSimulator, a novel training framework designed to improve the predictive ability of small LLMs for realistic user simulation on short-video platform environments. Specifically, OmniSimulator organizes behavior-oriented reasoning through a structured schema with five dimensions, carefully selects data from real user-behavior scenarios, and introduces a teacher model to generate high-quality reasoning traces under the proposed schema, helping small models learn behavior-relevant reasoning patterns rather than relying on superficial behavioral correlations. Based on this process, we construct 9,881 high-quality training instances from three months of historical interaction trajectories of 200 real users, averaging about 50 distilled examples per user. Experimental results show that OmniSimulator improves the average score of Qwen3-8B by 34.33%, achieves performance competitive with Claude-Sonnet-4.5, and supports smaller-scale, self-hosted deployment. These results suggest that learning structured behavior-oriented reasoning patterns is a promising direction towards scalable and high-fidelity LLM-based user simulation.
articles.titleCn: OmniSimulator：对齐小语言模型以实现真实异构行为建模
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）作为通用型用户模拟器在交互系统中展现出巨大潜力。已有研究表明，在高质量数据上进行训练可以显著提升模型的推理能力和下游任务表现。然而，用户模拟的上限仍受限于模型的推理范式：原生思维链推理往往退化为浅层模式匹配，无法充分模拟真实用户决策背后的行为因素。在本文中，我们提出了OmniSimulator，一个旨在提升小规模LLMs在短视频平台环境下进行真实用户模拟预测能力的新型训练框架。具体而言，OmniSimulator通过包含五个维度的结构化模式组织面向行为的推理，从真实用户行为场景中精心选择数据，并引入教师模型在所提模式下生成高质量推理轨迹，帮助小模型学习与行为相关的推理模式，而非依赖表层行为关联。基于此过程，我们从200名真实用户的3个月历史交互轨迹中构建了9881个高质量训练实例，平均每个用户约50个蒸馏示例。实验结果表明，OmniSimulator将Qwen3-8B的平均得分提升了34.33%，实现了与Claude-Sonnet-4.5相当的性能，并支持小规模、自部署。这些结果表明，学习结构化的面向行为推理模式是迈向可扩展、高保真LLM用户模拟的 promising 方向。

articles.title: Harness Scaling for Generalizable Agentic Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Agent harnesses have become a central component of modern agentic systems, shaping how models use tools, manage context, and coordinate long-horizon interaction. Realizing the benefits of these harnesses depends on how effectively the underlying model can make use of them, motivating reinforcement learning directly through the harness. However, existing approaches typically train through a single fixed harness, which can lead to specialization and limited transfer across harness configurations. To address this, we introduce \textbf{Harness Scaling}, a new scaling dimension for agentic RL that extends training from a single harness to diverse execution configurations. Concretely, we construct a factorized harness space, select a compact training subset with balanced factorial coverage, and organize cross-harness training to combine global coverage with controlled variation for the same task. Across multiple benchmarks, model scales, and RL algorithms, Harness Scaling consistently improves generalization to unseen white-box configurations. Moreover, models trained through structured white-box variation transfer effectively to unseen external black-box harnesses, outperforming models trained through a single complex black-box harness. These results establish harness diversity as a meaningful scaling dimension for agentic RL and highlight the importance of how this diversity is organized for cross-harness generalization.
articles.titleCn: 通用化智能体强化学习的适配器扩展
articles.abstractCn: 代理框架已成为现代代理系统中的核心组件，塑造了模型使用工具、管理上下文以及协调长时程交互的方式。要实现这些框架的益处，取决于底层模型如何有效地利用它们，从而直接通过框架进行强化学习。然而，现有方法通常通过单一固定的框架进行训练，这可能导致特定化和跨框架配置的迁移受限。为解决这一问题，我们引入了\textbf{框架扩展（Harness Scaling）}，这是一种新的代理强化学习扩展维度，将训练从单一框架扩展到多样化的执行配置。具体而言，我们构建了一个分因子化的框架空间，选择一个具有平衡因子覆盖的紧凑训练子集，并组织跨框架训练以结合全局覆盖和受控变异来处理同一任务。在多个基准测试、模型规模和强化学习算法中，框架扩展始终能提升模型对未见过的白盒配置的泛化能力。此外，通过结构化的白盒变异训练的模型能有效迁移到未见过的外部黑盒框架，其性能优于通过单一复杂黑盒框架训练的模型。这些结果确立了框架多样性作为代理强化学习的一种有意义的扩展维度，并突显了这种多样性组织方式对跨框架泛化的重要性。

articles.title: Omnilingual-MsASR: Benchmarking Multimodal, Multilingual, Long-Form Multi-Speaker ASR of Omni Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Omni-modal large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in audio and video understanding. However, existing models struggle with long-form, multi-speaker videos, especially in understanding the entire video and recognizing who says what and when. To characterize the capability limit of current omni LLMs and guide future model development, we introduce Omnilingual-MsASR, a multilingual, multimodal benchmark for long-form Multi-speaker Automatic Speech Recognition (MsASR) covering six languages, recordings up to 30 minutes, and scenarios with up to 20 speakers. Omnilingual-MsASR provides parallel audio and video inputs to evaluate models' cross-modal consistency and their ability to exploit complementary cues across modalities. Extensive evaluations of leading omni-modal LLMs reveal substantial performance bottlenecks, while their tcpWERs frequently exceed 100%. These findings highlight fine-grained temporal localization, speaker disambiguation, and cross-modal synergy as key challenges for future omni-modal foundation models. Our work is available at https://github.com/QwenLM/Omnilingua-Bench/tree/main/Omnilingua-MSpeaker.
articles.titleCn: Omnilingual-MsASR：对Omni大型语言模型的跨模态、多语言、长文本、多说话人语音识别进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 全模态大型语言模型（LLMs）在音频和视频理解方面取得了显著进展。然而，现有模型在处理长格式、多说话者的视频时面临挑战，尤其是在理解整个视频内容以及识别谁在何时说话方面。为了表征当前全模态LLMs的能力极限并指导未来模型的发展，我们引入了Omnilingual-MsASR，这是一个涵盖六种语言、录音时长最长可达30分钟、场景中最多20名说话者的多语言、多模态长格式多说话者自动语音识别（MsASR）基准。Omnilingual-MsASR提供并行音频和视频输入，用于评估模型的跨模态一致性及其利用跨模态互补信息的能力。对领先的全模态LLMs的广泛评估揭示了显著的性能瓶颈，而它们的tcpWER（字错误率）经常超过100%。这些发现突显了细粒度时间定位、说话者消歧和跨模态协同作用是未来全模态基础模型面临的关键挑战。我们的工作可在https://github.com/QwenLM/Omnilingua-Bench/tree/main/Omnilingua-MSpeaker获取。

articles.title: DynaWeave: Learning to Adapt through Dynamic Scenario Synthesis
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use tools to complete tasks in stateful environments. However, many training environments remain largely static apart from changes caused by the agent's own actions, whereas external events introduced by other users, services, or sudden contingencies in real environments can invalidate ongoing plans. To address this gap, we introduce DynaWeave, an automated synthesis framework that transforms existing static tasks into verifiable dynamic scenarios. The framework generates exogenous events relevant to each task, covering changes in task requirements, environment state, and external information. It uses directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) to represent dependencies between events and an execution engine to activate them during agent interaction. A dynamic verifier revises only the evaluation checks affected by events that actually occur and retains all other checks. Using DynaWeave, we collect 2,095 verified interaction trajectories across 36 environments and use them for supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5 models. Experiments on Gaia2, CostBench, and ToolMaze show that DynaWeave achieves consistent improvements in overall performance across all three evaluated model sizes, increasing the task completion rate on CostBench by 67.34 percentage points and even exceeding the performance of Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview on ToolMaze. These results support dynamic scenario synthesis as a practical approach to training agents to adapt to changing environments. Our code is available at https://github.com/Miaow-Lab/DynaWeave.
articles.titleCn: DynaWeave：通过动态场景合成学习适应
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地使用工具在状态化环境中完成任务。然而，许多训练环境除了由代理自身行为引起的改变外，在很大程度上保持静态，而真实环境中其他用户、服务或突发事件的引入可能会使正在进行的计划失效。为解决这一差距，我们引入了DynaWeave，这是一个自动化合成框架，将现有的静态任务转换为可验证的动态场景。该框架为每个任务生成相关的外生事件，涵盖任务需求的变化、环境状态的变化以及外部信息的变化。它使用有向无环图（DAG）来表示事件之间的依赖关系，并使用执行引擎在代理交互期间激活它们。动态验证器仅修改实际发生的事件影响到的评估检查，并保留所有其他检查。使用DynaWeave，我们在36个环境中收集了2,095条已验证的交互轨迹，并用于对Qwen3.5模型进行监督微调。在Gaia2、CostBench和ToolMaze上的实验表明，DynaWeave在所有三个评估模型尺寸上都实现了整体性能的持续提升，使CostBench的任务完成率提高了67.34个百分点，甚至在ToolMaze上超过了Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview的性能。这些结果支持动态场景合成作为训练代理适应变化环境的实用方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Miaow-Lab/DynaWeave获取。

articles.title: BIRD-RL: Scaling Agentic Reinforcement Learning over Stateful Data-Centric Environments
articles.abstract: While agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training small language models (SLMs), existing frameworks are predominantly tool-centric and struggle with data-centric environments. Specifically, applying tool-centric frameworks to stateful tasks like SQL debugging introduces severe spatial inefficiencies since proper environment isolation typically requires a separate database container per rollout. Naively reusing databases without tracking evolving states across multi-turn interactions causes trajectory contamination and cross-trajectory interference, which severely destabilizes policy updates. To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce BIRD-RL, a novel four-stage agentic RL curriculum that alternately enhances foundational agent reasoning and trajectory-adaptive on-policy exploration to circumvent the instability inherently associated with direct end-to-end learning. Crucially, to support this curriculum, BIRD-RL is driven by a Trajectory-scoped Persistent Execution Infrastructure, which enables safe database replica reuse while preserving trajectory isolation. This design improves spatial RL efficiency by 12.8x, successfully enabling scalable agentic RL for complex data-centric tasks without needs of Kubernettes. Empirical evaluations on the BIRD-CRITIC-SQLite benchmark demonstrate that our 7B and 14B models achieve Success Rates of 44.40% and 48.00%, respectively, showing competitive performance against strong proprietary model-based agents such as Claude-Opus-4.6 Agent (48.20%). Furthermore, BIRD-RL successfully trains unified SLMs capable of both advanced SQL debugging and generation, highlighting its broader potential for multi-objective optimization across heterogeneous, real-world data-centric tasks.
articles.titleCn: BIRD-RL：在状态化数据中心化环境中扩展自主强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 尽管自主强化学习（RL）已成为训练小语言模型（SLM）的一种有前景的范式，但现有框架大多是面向工具的，难以应对数据驱动的环境。具体来说，将面向工具的框架应用于SQL调试等状态化任务时，由于正确环境隔离通常需要为每个回滚创建单独的数据库容器，从而引入了严重的空间效率问题。未经追踪地重复使用数据库，而没有在多轮交互中跟踪状态演变，会导致轨迹污染和跨轨迹干扰，这严重破坏了策略更新。为了克服这些瓶颈，我们引入了BIRD-RL，这是一种新颖的四阶段自主强化学习课程，交替增强基础智能体推理和轨迹自适应的在线策略探索，以规避直接端到端学习内在的不稳定性。关键在于，为了支持这种课程，BIRD-RL由轨迹范围持久执行基础设施驱动，该基础设施能够在保持轨迹隔离的同时实现安全的数据库副本重用。这种设计将空间RL效率提高了12.8倍，成功实现了无需Kubernetes即可扩展的自主强化学习，以应对复杂的数据驱动任务。在BIRD-CRITIC-SQLite基准测试中的经验评估表明，我们的7B和14B模型分别达到了44.40%和48.00%的成功率，显示出与Claude-Opus-4.6 Agent（48.20%）等强大的专有基于模型的智能体相比具有竞争力的性能。此外，BIRD-RL成功训练了能够进行高级SQL调试和生成的统一SLM，突显了其在异构真实世界数据驱动任务中进行多目标优化的更广泛潜力。

articles.title: A KAN-based Non-linear Factorization for Embedding Layer Compression
articles.abstract: Among existing embedding compression approaches, low-rank factorization provides a simple and mathematically principled solution by approximating the embedding matrix with a reduced-rank decomposition. However, its practical effectiveness is often limited, as the resulting linear bottleneck constrains representational capacity. To overcome these limitations, we propose an enhanced factorization scheme that increases expressive power by introducing learnable non-linear projections within the compressed embedding layer. Our method is inspired by the Kolmogorov Arnold Networks (KAN) paradigm, which replaces fixed linear transformations with learnable univariate functions. Despite promising results in other domains, applications of KANs in NLP remain scarce and have so far been largely limited to final or task specific layers, rather than core representational components such as embedding layers. We evaluate the proposed approach by integrating the compressed embedding layer into the Skip-gram framework and comparing it against a standard low-rank baseline under matched parameter budgets on the Word Analogy and Semantic Similarity benchmarks. We further introduce an effective initialization strategy from a pre-trained, uncompressed embedding layer. The behavior of the model is analyzed both immediately after initialization and after a brief post-initialization refinement phase, considering training with the standard Skip-gram objective as well as variants augmented with distillation from the original embedding layer. Overall, our results show that augmenting low-rank factorization with learnable non-linear projections effectively mitigates the limitations of linear bottlenecks, yielding more faithful compressed embeddings under fixed dimensionality and suggesting a promising direction for embedding layer compression beyond purely linear methods.
