articles.titleCn: 基于KAN的非线性分解用于嵌入层压缩
articles.abstractCn: 在现有的嵌入压缩方法中，低秩分解通过用降秩分解来近似嵌入矩阵，提供了一种简单且具有数学原理的解决方案。然而，其实际效果往往受到限制，因为由此产生的线性瓶颈会限制表示能力。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种增强型分解方案，通过在压缩的嵌入层中引入可学习的非线性投影来提高表达能力。我们的方法受到柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺尔德网络（KAN）范式的启发，该范式用可学习的单变量函数替换固定的线性变换。尽管在其他领域取得了有希望的结果，但KAN在自然语言处理中的应用仍然稀缺，迄今为止主要局限于最终层或特定任务层，而不是核心表示组件，如嵌入层。我们通过将压缩的嵌入层集成到Skip-gram框架中，并在Word Analogy和Semantic Similarity基准测试上与具有匹配参数预算的标准低秩基线进行比较，评估了所提出的方法。我们进一步引入了一种从预训练的未压缩嵌入层有效初始化的策略。在初始化后立即以及经过短暂的初始化后微调阶段，分析了模型的行为，同时考虑了使用标准Skip-gram目标以及添加了从原始嵌入层蒸馏变体的训练。总的来说，我们的结果表明，通过可学习的非线性投影增强低秩分解，有效地缓解了线性瓶颈的限制，在固定维度下产生了更忠实的压缩嵌入，并暗示了超越纯粹线性方法的嵌入层压缩的 promising 方向。

articles.title: CCG Diffusion: Combinatory Categorial Grammar-Driven Compositional and Syntactically Disambiguated Text-to-Image Generation
articles.abstract: Text-to-image generation models do not explicitly receive the syntactic structure of the prompt, i.e., which word modifies which and where each phrase attaches. Consequently, they often struggle to bind attributes to the correct objects, to depict spatial relations and counts correctly, and to render syntactically ambiguous prompts in the intended interpretation. Existing syntax-based control methods mainly address attribute binding and have limited ability to control spatial relations and counts or to specify the interpretation of syntactically ambiguous prompts. They rely on phrase-structure or dependency grammars and require additional rules or constraints on the tree structure to extract modification relations between words or to specify a syntactic interpretation. We propose CCG Diffusion, a training-free method that controls image generation using Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG). In CCG, the category of each word carries rich syntactic information: it specifies what the word combines with and what phrase it forms. Modification relations between words can therefore be read directly from a CCG parse. Moreover, prepositional phrase (PP) attachment ambiguity, a representative syntactic ambiguity, can be resolved simply by fixing the preposition's category. CCG Diffusion applies the same two CCG-based mechanisms, prompt rewriting and attention guidance, both to controlling attribute binding, spatial relations, and counts and to resolving PP ambiguity. On two architecturally different backbones, Stable Diffusion and Sana, CCG Diffusion achieves the highest scores among the compared methods in attribute binding and 2D spatial relations and significantly outperforms all of them in PP ambiguity resolution.
articles.titleCn: CCG扩散：基于组合范畴语法驱动的、组合式且句法消歧的文本到图像生成
articles.abstractCn: 文本到图像生成模型不会明确接收提示的句法结构，即哪个词修饰哪个，以及每个短语如何连接。因此，它们通常难以将属性绑定到正确的对象，正确描绘空间关系和数量，以及以预期解释呈现句法模糊的提示。现有的基于句法的控制方法主要解决属性绑定问题，但在控制空间关系和数量或指定句法模糊提示解释方面能力有限。它们依赖于短语结构或依存语法，并需要额外的规则或约束来提取词之间的修饰关系或指定句法解释。我们提出了CCG Diffusion，这是一种无需训练的方法，它使用组合范畴语法（CCG）控制图像生成。在CCG中，每个词的类别包含丰富的句法信息：它指定了词的组合对象以及形成的短语。因此，词之间的修饰关系可以直接从CCG解析中读取。此外，介词短语（PP）连接模糊性是一种典型的句法模糊性，只需固定介词的类别即可简单地解决。CCG Diffusion将相同的两种基于CCG的机制——提示重写和注意力引导——应用于控制属性绑定、空间关系和数量，以及解决PP模糊性。在两个结构不同的主干网络Stable Diffusion和Sana上，CCG Diffusion在属性绑定和二维空间关系方面取得了与其他方法相比的最高分数，并在PP模糊性解决方面显著优于所有方法。

articles.title: Beyond Small Talk: Modeling Disclosure Trajectories in Human-AI Conversation
articles.abstract: Recently, we see a rise in conversational agents as a form of social and emotional support, where disclosure will unfold over time. Yet, current evaluations of these agents typically examine isolated conversational states. In analyses of naturally occurring conversations, disclosure history and current disclosure are confounded which tends to make their effects difficult to isolate. We thus introduce Trajectory-based Disclosure Evaluation (TraDE), an evaluation framework grounded in Social Penetration Theory that utilizes predefined disclosure trajectories and evaluates how preceding disclosure history shapes model behavior under matched current disclosure. Through the use of TraDE, we demonstrate across multiple models and relational behavior benchmarks that responses to disclosures matched on depth can differ depending on the preceding trajectory, particularly in whether models accept or challenge the user's framing. We also observed that these differences track accumulated exposure to deeper disclosure rather than any single moment of vulnerability or the order of disclosures. It also tends to persists for several turns after disclosure returns to shallow levels. For several behaviors, we also demonstrate that models diverge most consistently from human supporters in the Emotional Support Conversation corpus (ESConv) not when users open up but rather when they step back in their disclosure. TraDE thus provides a systematic way to expose history-dependent relational behavior that evaluations of isolated conversational states would otherwise miss.
articles.titleCn: 超越闲聊：人类-人工智能对话中的信息披露轨迹建模
articles.abstractCn: 近来，对话式代理作为一种社会与情感支持形式逐渐兴起，其中信息披露会随时间展开。然而，当前对这些代理的评估通常只考察孤立的对话状态。在自然对话的分析中，信息披露历史与当前信息披露往往相互混淆，这使得它们的影响难以分离。因此，我们引入了基于轨迹的信息披露评估框架（TraDE），该框架基于社会渗透理论，利用预定义的信息披露轨迹，评估在匹配的当前信息披露下，先前信息披露历史如何塑造模型行为。通过使用TraDE，我们在多个模型和关系行为基准上证明，对于深度匹配的信息披露，模型的回应会因先前的轨迹而异，尤其是在模型是否接受或挑战用户的框架方面。我们还观察到，这些差异与对更深层次信息披露的累积接触有关，而非任何单一脆弱时刻或信息披露的顺序。此外，当信息披露回归浅层水平后，这种差异往往会持续数个回合。对于某些行为，我们还证明，在情感支持对话语料库（ESConv）中，模型与人类支持者的一致性最低，并非在用户敞开心扉时，而是在他们收回信息披露时。因此，TraDE提供了一种系统的方法，揭示了依赖于历史的关联行为，而这些行为在孤立的对话状态评估中会被忽略。

articles.title: ECHO: Emergent Common-Mode Hidden Offsets Drive Vocabulary Collapse in Preference Optimization
articles.abstract: Preference optimization can improve every ranking metric while building a hidden, shared representation shift that the relative loss barely sees, one that can eventually destroy generation. We trace this failure to the common-mode offset, a shared directional shift in the model's hidden states that appears across token positions, prompts, and both chosen and rejected responses. Because it moves chosen and rejected representations together, the relative ranking loss barely reacts to its accumulation. As this offset grows, it projects onto the output layer to form a vocabulary well, elevating a single token's probability until it dominates decoding and causes generation collapse. The isolated offset alone reconstructs the vocabulary well, injecting the learned offset into an untreated base model recreates the collapse where norm-matched random directions do not, and masking this common component from the loss prevents the well in our flagship setting. Under the per-token ranking loss we study, the same collapse appears in 14 of 17 base-model lineages and under full-parameter fine-tuning. Moreover, the offset is not merely an artifact of collapse, since it is already present in textbook DPO and SimPO runs that form no well. Textbook DPO keeps it weakly aligned with any single vocabulary direction even with three times our base budget. Trained from base models for that budget, however, full-parameter SimPO drives it into collapse on both Llama-2 and Llama-3.1, and the same kind of offset grows, without a well, from a public SFT checkpoint under the official SimPO recipe. Across 17 UltraFeedback runs, the better a run ranks held-out responses, the less often two public reward models prefer its samples to the base model's. These findings expose a blind spot in standard ranking metrics and introduce a representation-level signal that can warn of generation collapse before it occurs.
articles.titleCn: ECHO：涌现共模隐藏偏移驱动偏好优化中的词汇崩溃
articles.abstractCn: 偏好优化可以在构建一个隐藏的共享表征偏移的同时提升所有排名指标，这个偏移使得相对损失几乎无法察觉，最终会导致生成崩溃。我们将这种失败归因于共模偏移，即模型隐藏状态中的一种共享方向性偏移，它出现在不同标记位置、提示以及被选择和拒绝的响应中。由于它将选择和拒绝的表征一起移动，相对排名损失几乎不会对其累积做出反应。随着这种偏移的增长，它投影到输出层形成词汇井，提升单个标记的概率直到它主导解码并导致生成崩溃。单独的偏移就能重建词汇井，将学习到的偏移注入未经处理的基模型中会重现崩溃，而匹配范数的随机方向却不会；并且在我们旗舰设置中，屏蔽这种共模分量会阻止词汇井的形成。在我们研究的每标记排名损失中，17个基模型谱系中的14个以及全参数微调下都会出现同样的崩溃。此外，偏移不仅仅是崩溃的产物，因为它已经存在于形成不了词汇井的标准DPO和SimPO运行中。标准DPO即使在三倍于我们基模型预算的情况下，仍将其与任何单个词汇方向保持微弱对齐。然而，从为该预算训练的基模型开始，全参数SimPO在Llama-2和Llama-3.1上都会将其推向崩溃，并且相同类型的偏移在官方SimPO配方下从公开的SFT检查点开始，没有词汇井地增长。在17次UltraFeedback运行中，运行对保留响应的排名越好，两个公共奖励模型就越少倾向于其样本而不是基模型的样本。这些发现揭示了标准排名指标中的一个盲点，并引入了一种表征级别的信号，可以在生成崩溃发生之前发出警告。

articles.title: Right On Q: Recovering Reasoning under Quantization via Self-Generated Trajectories
articles.abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) aims to recover reasoning capabilities in low-bit large language models (LLMs). Existing recipes typically supervise the quantized student with the original full-precision model on fixed response sequences. However, the resulting low-bit quantized models still struggle on long-horizon reasoning tasks and often fail to terminate within a token budget that suffices for the full-precision model. We identify two challenges in closing this gap. First, fixed-response supervision leaves a mismatch between training prefixes and those encountered during student generation, and this trajectory divergence grows as responses lengthen. Second, on its own prefixes, the student underpredicts some next-token candidates and overpredicts others, and this distributional misalignment becomes more frequent at high-entropy prefixes. We present OnQ, a low-bit recovery pipeline that combines on-policy distillation and candidate-wise Dynamic KL. Starting from block-wise calibration, the quantized student generates responses and receives full-precision teacher supervision on its own prefixes. Dynamic KL weights forward and reverse KL by each candidate's teacher-student probability ratio to balance correction of under- and overprediction. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B at 2- and 3-bit precision, OnQ achieves the highest nine-benchmark average, with the largest gains on long-horizon reasoning benchmarks. At 2 bits, it outperforms every baseline on every benchmark at every model size, improving the Qwen3-8B average by 10.26 points over the strongest baseline. It also produces shorter responses with fewer truncations and repetitive errors.
articles.titleCn: 《精准量化下的推理恢复：通过自生成轨迹》
articles.abstractCn: 量化感知训练（QAT）旨在恢复低比特大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。现有方法通常在固定的响应序列上用原始全精度模型监督量化学生模型。然而，得到的低比特量化模型在长时程推理任务上仍存在困难，并且往往无法在足以满足全精度模型的标记预算内终止。我们识别出两个缩小这一差距的挑战。首先，固定响应监督导致训练前缀与学生生成时遇到的前缀之间存在不匹配，并且随着响应长度增加，这种轨迹偏差会加剧。其次，在仅有的前缀上，学生模型对某些下一个标记候选的预测不足，而对另一些则预测过度，这种分布偏差在高熵前缀上更为频繁。我们提出了OnQ，一种结合了策略内蒸馏和候选动态KL的低比特恢复流程。从块级校准开始，量化学生模型生成响应，并在其自身前缀上接收全精度教师模型的监督。动态KL通过每个候选的教师-学生概率比率对正向和反向KL进行加权，以平衡对预测不足和预测过度的修正。在2比特和3比特精度下，对Qwen3-1.7B、4B和8B模型进行测试，OnQ实现了最高的九基准平均分，并在长时程推理基准上取得了最大增益。在2比特精度下，它在每个模型尺寸的每个基准上都优于所有基线，相较于最强基线将Qwen3-8B平均分提升了10.26分。它还生成了更短的响应，减少了截断和重复错误。

articles.title: Memory-Centric Continual Learning for AI Agents
articles.abstract: Autonomous agents powered by foundation models can reason, plan, and use tools, but their fixed weights and context limits hinder sustained learning from experience over long-term deployment. While external memory systems attempt to bridge this gap, they mostly act as passive retrieval caches, evaluated primarily by whether they can recall stored facts or past interactions. Whether memory can drive genuine continual learning remains an open question. In this paper, we introduce Memory-Centric Continual Learning (MCCL), arguing that memory should be judged by whether it improves future actions, not merely what it retrieves. MCCL has three main parts. First, a three-axis taxonomy organizes memory by where state is stored (substrates), what form it takes (assets), and how it is managed (policies). This defines a two-loop lifecycle that updates memory state in an inner loop while refining management policies in an outer loop based on task feedback. Second, an evaluation protocol measures retention under interference, adaptation to change, and task transfer to isolate genuine behavioral gains from simple context expansion. Third, a memory scaling framework models how agent performance scales with experience, storage capacity, and compute budgets across non-parametric and parametric memory. Together, these components reframe agent memory from passive lookup to continuous learning, offering a principled route toward self-improving autonomous agents.
articles.titleCn: 面向人工智能代理的记忆中心持续学习
articles.abstractCn: 基于基础模型的自主智能体能够推理、规划和使用工具，但它们固定的权重和上下文限制阻碍了在长期部署中从经验中持续学习。虽然外部记忆系统试图弥补这一差距，但它们大多充当被动的检索缓存，主要根据其能否回忆存储的事实或过去的交互来评估。记忆能否驱动真正的持续学习仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在本文中，我们引入了以记忆为中心的持续学习（MCCL），认为记忆应该根据它是否改进未来的行动来评判，而不仅仅是它检索了什么。MCCL包含三个主要部分。首先，一个三维分类法根据状态存储的位置（基质）、记忆的形式（资产）以及管理方式（策略）对记忆进行组织。这定义了一个双环生命周期，在内环中更新记忆状态，同时在外环中根据任务反馈完善管理策略。其次，一个评估协议测量在干扰下的保持能力、对变化的适应能力以及任务迁移能力，以将真正的行为增益与简单的上下文扩展区分开来。第三，一个记忆扩展框架模拟了智能体性能如何随着经验、存储容量和计算预算在非参数和参数记忆中扩展。这些组件一起将智能体记忆从被动查找转变为持续学习，为构建自我改进的自主智能体提供了一条原则性途径。

articles.title: Don't Stop Long-Context Continual Pre-Training Too Early: An Empirical Scaling Law
articles.abstract: Long-context continual pre-training (LCCP) is widely used to improve long-context capability, but how its benefits scale with the number of tokens used for LCCP remains unclear. We investigate this question through modeling, monitoring, and validating the benefits of scaling LCCP. First, we establish an empirical additive power law relating long-context performance to model size and the respective token budgets of short-context pre-training and LCCP. Experiments across five model scales and more than one hundred short- and long-context budget configurations show that the fitted law reproduces the observed trends and extrapolates well to held-out model scales. Second, we introduce \textsc{Constant-Last4}, a training and observation protocol that averages the four most recent consecutive checkpoints from a constant-learning-rate run to enable stable monitoring along a single extensible training trajectory. Under this protocol, the same scaling-law form fits well and accurately predicts the LCCP performance trajectory of a 1.22B-parameter model trained on approximately 100B LCCP tokens. Finally, downstream evaluations along this trajectory show continued improvements in long-context performance, with no clear sign of saturation within the evaluated range. These gains persist after both 128K context extension and supervised fine-tuning, with benefits extending to long-context understanding and agentic tasks. Together, these results argue for continuing to scale LCCP rather than stopping early: its gains are stably observable along an extensible trajectory, quantitatively predictable, and transferable to downstream tasks.
articles.titleCn: 不要过早停止长上下文持续预训练：一项经验缩放定律
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文持续预训练（LCCP）被广泛用于提升长上下文能力，但其收益如何随着用于LCCP的token数量增加而扩展尚不明确。我们通过建模、监控和验证扩展LCCP的收益来研究这一问题。首先，我们建立了一个经验性加性幂律，将长上下文性能与模型规模以及短上下文预训练和LCCP各自的token预算相关联。跨越五个模型规模和超过一百种短上下文和长上下文预算配置的实验表明，该拟合规律能够重现观测趋势，并很好地外推到未包含的模型规模。其次，我们引入了\textsc{Constant-Last4}，这是一种训练和观测协议，它将恒定学习率运行中的最近四个连续检查点取平均，以在单个可扩展训练轨迹上实现稳定的监控。在该协议下，相同的扩展规律拟合良好，并能准确预测一个在约100B LCCP token上训练的1.22B参数模型的LCCP性能轨迹。最后，沿着这一轨迹进行的下游评估显示，长上下文性能持续提升，在评估范围内没有明显的饱和迹象。这些收益在经过128K上下文扩展和监督微调后依然存在，其优势扩展到长上下文理解和代理任务。综合这些结果，我们主张继续扩展LCCP而不是过早停止：其收益在可扩展轨迹上稳定可观测，定量可预测，并能迁移到下游任务。

articles.title: Closed-Loop Dual-Reference Guidance for Accent Control in Cross-Lingual Voice Cloning
articles.abstract: Zero-shot cross-lingual voice cloning often carries the reference speaker's accent into the target language. We propose closed-loop dual-reference guidance, which pairs the original reference with a reusable native anchor constructed by voice conversion (VC). The references initialize separate language-model (LM) states that guide a shared acoustic trajectory; each completed patch then updates both states, keeping their generated histories aligned with the emitted speech. Anchor construction runs once per speaker, and online synthesis uses a frozen TTS model without per-utterance VC. On 20 held-out French speakers, the fixed setting $λ^{\!*}=0.33$ reduces residual French LID mass by 73\% versus direct cloning, at an ECAPA similarity cost of only $0.042$; relative to anchor-only cloning, it recovers $0.155$. The method achieves the lowest mean WER ($0.009$) and highest mean GOP ($4.750$) among the held-out test arms. In blinded preference tests, native-English listeners favor it over direct cloning on pronunciation naturalness, and over both anchor-only cloning and a TTS$\to$VC cascade on speaker identity. Online RTF is approximately 26\% lower than the cascade's ($0.59$ vs.\ $0.80$), and the same setting reduces Spanish LID mass by 56\% without re-tuning.
articles.titleCn: 闭环双参考语音克隆中的重音控制
articles.abstractCn: 零样本跨语言语音克隆通常会将参考说话人的口音带入目标语言。我们提出了闭环双参考引导方法，将原始参考与通过语音转换（VC）构建的可重用母语锚点进行配对。参考说话人会初始化不同的语言模型（LM）状态，这些状态会引导共享的声学轨迹；每个完成的片段会更新这两个状态，使它们生成的历史与发出的语音保持一致。锚点构建对每个说话人只运行一次，在线合成使用冻结的TTS模型，无需每句话进行VC。在20个保留的法国说话人测试中，固定设置$λ^{\!*}=0.33$与直接克隆相比，将残余法语LID质量降低了73%，而ECAPA相似度成本仅为$0.042$；与仅使用锚点的克隆相比，它恢复了$0.155$。该方法在保留测试分支中实现了最低的平均WER（$0.009$）和最高的平均GOP（$4.750$）。在盲法偏好测试中，母语为英语的听众在发音自然度上更偏爱该方法，在说话人身份上更偏爱仅使用锚点的克隆和TTS$\to$VC级联方法。在线RTF比级联方法低约26%（$0.59$ vs.\ $0.80$），相同的设置在不重新调优的情况下将西班牙语LID质量降低了56%。

articles.title: B-CARE: Blind Classwise Assessment of Relative Evidence for Stance Error Ranking
articles.abstract: Stance classifiers make errors that can be costly to identify under limited human-review budgets. Prioritizing potentially incorrect predictions remains challenging, particularly across heterogeneous base models. We introduce B-CARE (Blind Classwise Assessment of Relative Evidence for Stance Error Ranking), a prediction-blind framework for identifying high-risk stance predictions. Given only a target and text, a fixed LLM verifier assigns ordinal evidence scores to all candidate stance labels without observing the base model's prediction or confidence. B-CARE constructs a comparative risk score by contrasting the strongest alternative-class evidence with the evidence supporting the predicted class. The resulting classwise evidence profile can be reused across multiple base models without training a separate error detector or calibrating risk scores. We evaluate B-CARE on four stance benchmarks and three heterogeneous base LLMs, covering 12 dataset-model settings and 5,206 unique test instances. Evaluation includes error-ranking discrimination (AUROC and AUPRC), selective prediction (E-AURC), and review effectiveness (ErrorCapture at fixed review budgets). B-CARE achieves a mean AUROC of 0.735 and a mean AUPRC of 0.524, capturing 41.06% of errors within the highest-risk 20% of predictions. Although B-CARE does not uniformly outperform strong confidence-based baselines, it provides a reusable, complementary evidence signal for prioritizing potentially incorrect stance predictions across heterogeneous models.
articles.titleCn: B-CARE：立场错误排序的相对证据的盲类评估
articles.abstractCn: 立场分类器在有限的人工审核预算下可能会出现代价高昂的错误。优先处理可能错误的预测仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在异构基础模型之间。我们引入了B-CARE（盲分类相对证据评估用于立场错误排序），这是一种预测盲的框架，用于识别高风险立场预测。仅给定目标和文本，固定的LLM验证器会为所有候选立场标签分配序数证据分数，而无需观察基础模型的预测或置信度。B-CARE通过对比最强替代类证据与支持预测类的证据来构建比较风险分数。由此产生的分类证据配置可以在多个基础模型之间重复使用，而无需训练单独的错误检测器或校准风险分数。我们在四个立场基准和三个异构基础LLM上评估了B-CARE，涵盖12个数据集-模型设置和5,206个唯一测试实例。评估包括错误排序区分（AUROC和AUPRC）、选择性预测（E-AURC）和审核有效性（固定审核预算下的ErrorCapture）。B-CARE实现了平均AUROC为0.735，平均AUPRC为0.524，在最高风险20%的预测中捕获了41.06%的错误。尽管B-CARE并不总是优于强置信度基线，但它为跨异构模型优先处理可能错误的立场预测提供了一种可重复使用的、补充的证据信号。

articles.title: Data Schedules and Learning Rate Schedules Should Be Designed Together
articles.abstract: Mid-training (MT) is a training phase in LLM training pipelines that continues pretraining (PT) on smaller datasets of higher value. Taking the PT and MT phases as a whole, training usually starts with only PT data and then transitions completely to MT data. In this work, we view this complete transition from PT to MT data as a special case of a broader class of data mixing schedules that specify how the proportions of PT and MT tokens in each batch change over training. Under fixed total training compute and MT token budgets, we ask: Is this complete transition to MT data optimal for minimizing final MT loss? We show that the answer depends on the learning rate (LR) schedule: one data schedule may outperform another under one LR schedule, but changing only the LR schedule can reverse the outcome. Specifically, when the LR decays throughout continued training, introducing MT data earlier and mixing it with PT data lowers the final MT loss compared with placing all MT data at the end of training, but this result is reversed if we use constant LR. We therefore study how to jointly choose when to introduce MT data and when to decay the LR through ablation studies, and find that it is better to decay the LR only after MT data enters training. Finally, we develop a theoretical model that explains why the optimal data schedule for a fixed MT token budget depends on the LR schedule.
articles.titleCn: 数据计划和学习率计划应一并设计
articles.abstractCn: 中间训练（MT）是LLM训练流程中的一个训练阶段，它继续在更小但价值更高的数据集上进行预训练（PT）。将PT和MT阶段整体来看，训练通常从仅使用PT数据开始，然后完全过渡到MT数据。在这项工作中，我们将从PT到MT数据的完整过渡视为更广泛的数据混合调度类别中的一个特例，该类别指定了训练过程中每个批次中PT和MT标记比例的变化方式。在固定的总训练计算量和MT标记预算下，我们提出：这种完全过渡到MT数据是否最优，以最小化最终的MT损失？我们表明，答案取决于学习率（LR）调度：在一种LR调度下，一种数据调度可能优于另一种，但仅改变LR调度可以逆转结果。具体来说，当LR在整个持续训练过程中衰减时，较早引入MT数据并将其与PT数据混合，与将所有MT数据放在训练结束时相比，可以降低最终的MT损失，但如果使用恒定LR，这一结果会被逆转。因此，我们通过消融研究研究如何联合选择何时引入MT数据以及何时衰减LR，发现仅在MT数据进入训练后才衰减LR更好。最后，我们开发了一个理论模型，解释了为什么在固定的MT标记预算下，最优数据调度取决于LR调度。

articles.title: Decodability Is Not Controllability: Local and Anisotropic Speaker Control in Continuous-Latent TTS
articles.abstract: High linear decodability does not entail causal controllability in continuous-latent text-to-speech (TTS). In VoxCPM2, position-matched probes and equal-norm interventions across 30 speakers and 60 directed dyads expose this separation: reference-audio states at the final residual acoustic language model layer (RALM L7) retain 0.970 probe accuracy, yet aligned edits yield 0/60 target-dominant dyads. Edits at early reference-audio positions produce the opposite pattern. At L0, pair-aligned updates increase target similarity by 0.326 and achieve target dominance in all 60 dyads, against at most 1/60 under any equal-norm direction or position control. Independent speaker encoders, retrieval against held-out speaker prototypes, and double-blind listening confirm that the shifted voice is heard as the intended target. Cross-architecture interventions in dots.tts distinguish backbone leverage from direct acoustic control: backbone edits displace the source without target attraction, while x-vector ablation reduces source similarity from 0.849 to 0.006. These findings identify two requirements for training-free speaker control: geometric specificity and a computational route that carries the intended speaker condition into acoustic synthesis.
articles.titleCn: 解码性并非可控性：连续潜在语音合成中的局部和各向异性说话人控制
articles.abstractCn: 高线性解码能力并不必然意味着在连续潜在文本到语音（TTS）系统中具有因果可控性。在VoxCPM2中，跨30名说话人和60个定向二重体的位置匹配探针和等范数干预揭示了这种分离：最终残差声学语言模型层（RALM L7）的参考音频状态保留了0.970的探针准确率，但匹配编辑产生了0/60的目标主导二重体。早期参考音频位置的编辑则产生了相反的模式。在L0处，对齐的更新使目标相似度提高了0.326，并在所有60个二重体中实现了目标主导，而任何等范数方向或位置控制下的相似度最多仅为1/60。独立的说话人编码器、对保留的说话人原型的检索以及双盲聆听证实，移动后的声音被感知为预期的目标。在dots.tts中的跨架构干预区分了骨干利用和直接声学控制：骨干编辑使源音移位而不产生目标吸引，而x-vector消融将源相似度从0.849降至0.006。这些发现确定了无训练说话人控制的两个要求：几何特异性和一个能够将预期说话人条件传递到声学合成的计算路径。

articles.title: Uncensored Is Not Unbiased: Abliteration Removes Refusals but Not Script-Dependent Bias About Taiwan
articles.abstract: "Abliterated" ("uncensored") builds of open-weight language models remove the activation direction that mediates refusal, and are popular partly on the assumption that a model that no longer refuses is also free of political censorship. We test this on two matched pairs of 2-bit models: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, each against a community abliteration. Each model judged 22 statement pairs (on the Republic of China (Taiwan), 1989 Tiananmen, control countries) in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese (a character-level conversion) and English, and answered 27 open questions per script. Script mattered far more than abliteration: the original Bolt scored +0.58 on Index S (-1: People's Republic of China (PRC) position; +1: ROC position) in Traditional Chinese, +0.57 in English and +0.05 in Simplified Chinese, and affirmed "Taiwan is part of the PRC" with probability 0.91 in Simplified but 0.06 in Traditional characters; abliteration changed its scores by at most 0.06, mostly by raising "yes" on both sides. In Qwen, abliteration removed every refusal on 1989 and raised scores by 0.21 to 0.34, yet the abliterated Qwen still affirmed that Taiwan is part of the PRC in all three scripts. Naming the state the Republic of China (Taiwan) raised every model's score by 0.10 to 0.33 but left the script gap. Control pairs showed no script gap; each abliteration changed only its declared tensors. In 740,000 web documents, Simplified text on Taiwan contained PRC-framing terms 3.7 times as often as Traditional text. A script direction could not be steered away; a contrastive stance direction raised scores in every script, and its negation lowered them. A four-sentence system prompt raised the abliterated Qwen to +0.93 to +0.97. Keyword scoring rules failed the models closest to the ROC position mostly for attributing or denying the PRC claim. Uncensored is not unbiased.
articles.comment: 33 pages, 3 figures, 18 tables. Code, data and an interactive project page: https://daaab.github.io/uncensored-not-unbiased/
articles.titleCn: 未审查不等于无偏见：移除拒绝行为并不能消除与脚本相关的关于台湾的偏见

articles.title: Reader--Writer Coupling in Transformer MLPs
articles.abstract: A transformer MLP gives each hidden channel two roles: a reader that decides when the channel responds, and a writer that decides what it adds back to the residual stream. Read as a key--value memory, the layer can be measured one factor set at a time: the pairing of readers to writers is carried only by their shared index, invisible to any quantity computed from one factor set alone. Yet training couples the two factors through their joint update, so we ask what reading them together shows. The block supplies the joint instrument: the MLP writes back into the very stream it reads, so the exact Jacobian of its update is square, and its agreement with its own transpose resolves into reader--writer terms whose inner products give each channel, read as a couple, a signed pairing coordinate. Ranked by this coordinate, each block we measure has a small core of strongly coupled channels; where initialization gives either sign equally, the core is nearly all opposed: each writer points against the direction its reader responds to. This opposed core recurs from the smallest models trained from scratch to released checkpoints; its sign is in place within a few percent of training and holds while the coupling grows. Read as couples, most channels return their contribution against the reader that fired it, and the readers of later blocks take it up; few show in the logits. Training holds the couples in place: flipping the opposed writers moves the output toward common tokens, and a writer permuted onto another reader regrows to fit that reader while the reader stays.
articles.titleCn: Transformer MLP中的读写耦合
articles.abstractCn: 一个Transformer MLP为每个隐藏通道赋予两种角色：一个“读取器”决定通道何时响应，一个“写入器”决定它向残差流中添加什么。将其视为键值存储时，该层可以逐个因素集进行测量：读取器与写入器的配对仅由它们的共享索引承载，而单独从任何一个因素集计算出的任何量都无法察觉。然而训练通过联合更新将这两个因素耦合在一起，因此我们询问同时读取它们会显示什么。该模块提供了联合工具：MLP将其写入它读取的同一流中，因此其更新的精确雅可比矩阵是方阵，并且它与自身转置的一致性分解为读取器-写入器项，这些项的内积为每个通道（作为一对读取）提供一个带符号的配对坐标。按此坐标排序，我们测量的每个模块都有一小部分强耦合通道；在初始化赋予正负号相同时，核心几乎完全相反：每个写入器都指向其读取器响应的反方向。这种相反的核心从从头训练的最小模型到发布的检查点都反复出现；其符号在训练开始后的几个百分点内就确定下来，并在耦合增长时保持不变。作为一对读取时，大多数通道会对其触发的读取器返回其贡献，而后续模块的读取器接着承接；很少在logits中显示。训练将这些配对固定下来：翻转相反的写入器会使输出朝向常见标记移动，而将一个写入器置换到另一个读取器上时，它会重新生长以适应那个读取器，而读取器保持不变。

articles.title: ChronoSynth: Constraint-Aware Question Synthesis over Temporal Knowledge Graphs
articles.abstract: Knowledge graph question generation (KGQG) generates natural-language questions from structured graph evidence and a target answer. When the input graph is temporal, a valid question must also preserve the answer field, time condition, reference event, and temporal order that determine the answer set. Existing KGQG methods and prompting baselines can produce fluent questions that alter these conditions, causing temporal semantic drift. This paper studies temporal KGQG as a constraint-preserving graph-to-question problem and proposes ChronoSynth, a memory-augmented and constraint-aware generation framework. ChronoSynth first constructs a Temporal Intent State to make the intended question semantics explicit. It then retrieves compatible typed question patterns from an indexed pattern memory, adapts them to the input graph, and validates the generated question. Validation feedback guides revisions when a supported inconsistency is detected. Experiments on CRONQUESTIONS and MultiTQ demonstrate state-of-the-art generation performance, with ablations supporting the contributions of its components.
articles.titleCn: ChronoSynth：时序知识图谱上的约束感知问题合成
articles.abstractCn: 知识图谱问题生成（KGQG）从结构化图证据和目标答案生成自然语言问题。当输入图具有时序性时，一个有效的问题必须保留决定答案集的答案字段、时间条件、参考事件和时序顺序。现有的KGQG方法和提示基线可以生成流畅的问题，但这些问题会改变这些条件，导致时序语义漂移。本文将时序KGQG研究为一种保持约束的图到问题问题，并提出ChronoSynth，这是一个带记忆增强和约束感知的生成框架。ChronoSynth首先构建一个时序意图状态，使预期问题的语义显式化。然后从索引模式内存中检索兼容的类型化问题模式，将其适应输入图，并验证生成的问题。验证反馈在检测到支持的不一致性时指导修订。在CRONQUESTIONS和MultiTQ上的实验展示了最先进的生成性能，消融实验支持其组件的贡献。

articles.title: Policy Central: Detecting Conflicts, Redundancy, and Similarity in Deployed Police Policy
articles.abstract: Policy Central is a deployed system that helps police departments find relationships between sections of their written policy: whether two sections conflict, are redundant, are merely similar, or are different. We describe the system and compare two architectures. Retrieve-Judge, a retrieve-then-classify pipeline, runs as a cheap library-wide health signal; Screen-Confirm, a screen-then-confirm cascade, is a selective audit of the documents a reviewer chooses, checking them exhaustively against one another. On a 302-pair benchmark drawn from one department's ~84 real policy documents, given each pair Screen-Confirm reaches 0.795 aggregate recall and 0.885 on Conflict, so current models judge well. Finding the pair is the hard part: Retrieve-Judge's composed recall falls to 0.457, and Screen-Confirm recovers 0.472 (0.615 on Conflict). Today these pairs are found by reading the whole library, nearly 20,000 sections, checked against one another and re-checked after every revision. A scan that returns half of them in minutes, at low cost, and can be re-run on demand changes the economics of policy review even before recall improves.
articles.titleCn: 政策中心：检测部署中的警察政策的冲突、冗余和相似性
articles.abstractCn: 政策中心是一个已部署的系统，旨在帮助警察部门发现其书面政策各部分之间的关系：判断两个部分是否存在冲突、冗余、相似或不同。我们描述了该系统，并比较了两种架构。Retrieve-Judge是一种检索后分类的流水线架构，作为整个库的廉价健康信号运行；Screen-Confirm是一种筛选后确认的级联架构，是对审阅者选择的文档进行选择性审计，将它们相互彻底检查。在一个包含302对基准测试的实验中，这些对来自一个部门约84份真实政策文档，Screen-Confirm在总体召回率上达到0.795，在冲突检测上达到0.885，因此当前模型判断效果良好。找到这些对才是难点：Retrieve-Judge的复合召回率降至0.457，而Screen-Confirm恢复到0.472（冲突检测上为0.615）。目前这些对是通过阅读整个库——近20,000个部分——相互检查并在每次修订后重新检查来发现的。一种能在几分钟内返回其中一半结果、低成本且可按需重新运行的扫描方式，即使召回率尚未提高，也改变了政策审查的经济性。

articles.title: Seeing the Forest for the Trees: Emergent Agreement from Individual Conversations
articles.abstract: As LLM agents interact in the wild and shape each other's decisions, understanding how they converge toward agreement becomes important. We study this in multi-turn conversations where two LLMs discuss subjective matters, can agree or disagree, and may change their stances. Using a linear classifier on individual conversation activations, we identify an internal representation of agreement. We find that it varies substantially across turns and conversations and does not reliably track external agreement at the individual conversation level. We therefore move beyond the representation of agreement in individual conversations, by aggregating the agreement representation across conversations. Externally, this aggregate view reveals a simple structure: when pooled across conversations, agreement can be predicted well with a Markov process, with agreement at each turn being a direct function of agreement at the previous turn. Similarly, when internal agreement is aggregated, it couples with the external Markov agreement through a power-law mapping, exposing Markovian dynamics in internal representations. Additionally, we find that after a change of stance, models express agreement externally before their internal representations reflect the same shift. These results reveal a joint structure between internal and external agreement that emerges only when internal features are aggregated across conversations. Code available at https://github.com/technion-cs-nlp/SeeingTheForestForTheTrees.
articles.titleCn: 只见树木，不见森林：个体对话中的涌现性共识
articles.abstractCn: 随着大语言模型代理在真实环境中互动并相互影响决策，理解它们如何趋同达成一致变得至关重要。我们在多轮对话中研究这一问题，其中两个大语言模型讨论主观议题，可以达成一致或持有不同意见，并可能改变立场。通过在单个对话激活上使用线性分类器，我们识别出了一种内部一致性的表征。我们发现这种表征在对话轮次和对话之间差异很大，并且无法可靠地追踪单个对话层面的外部一致性。因此，我们通过跨对话聚合一致性表征，超越了单个对话中一致性的表征。在外部层面，这种聚合视图揭示了一种简单结构：当跨对话聚合时，一致性可以用马尔可夫过程很好地预测，每一轮的一致性是上一轮一致性的直接函数。类似地，当内部一致性被聚合时，它通过幂律映射与外部马尔可夫一致性耦合，揭示了内部表征中的马尔可夫动态。此外，我们发现立场改变后，模型在外部表达一致性的时间早于其内部表征反映相同转变的时间。这些结果揭示了一种内部和外部一致性之间的联合结构，这种结构仅在跨对话聚合内部特征时才会出现。代码可在 https://github.com/technion-cs-nlp/SeeingTheForestForTheTrees 获取。

articles.title: OACap: Caption-Guided Active Observation for Detailed Video Captioning
articles.abstract: Unlike question answering, where a query specifies a perceptual target, open-ended detailed captioning must determine what evidence to acquire and how to integrate it into a coherent global description. We propose Observation-Adaptive Video Captioner (OACap), a caption-centered agent that turns unsupported or missing information into targeted observation requests, uses spatiotemporal tools to acquire evidence, and iteratively verifies and revises the caption. OACap captions consistently improve performance across general video-understanding benchmarks using a fixed text-only reader. To better diagnose the information they preserve, we introduce Factual-Semantic Captioning Bench (FSCap-Bench). Its Core-Support Factuality Score (CSFS) combines claim precision with importance-aware fact coverage and responds as expected to four controlled perturbation types on 93.0-98.3% of valid caption pairs. Its Cross-Modal Semantic Round-Trip Score (CSRS) measures semantic preservation through a video-caption-video-caption round trip by matching atomic facts from source and recovered captions. Together, they connect downstream textual-memory utility with factual and semantic preservation.
articles.titleCn: OACap：基于字幕引导的主动观察技术，用于详细视频字幕生成
articles.abstractCn: 与问答任务不同，问答任务中的查询指定了感知目标，而开放式详细描述则必须确定要获取哪些证据以及如何将其整合成一个连贯的整体描述。我们提出了观察自适应视频描述器（OACap），这是一个以描述为中心的智能体，它将不支持的或缺失的信息转化为有针对性的观察请求，使用时空工具获取证据，并迭代地验证和修改描述。OACap使用固定的纯文本阅读器，在通用视频理解基准测试中始终如一地提高了性能。为了更好地诊断它们保留的信息，我们引入了事实语义描述基准（FSCap-Bench）。其核心支持事实性分数（CSFS）结合了声明精确度与重要性感知的事实覆盖范围，并在93.0-98.3%的有效描述对中按预期响应四种受控扰动类型。其跨模态语义往返分数（CSRS）通过匹配源描述和恢复描述中的原子事实来衡量语义保留，通过视频-描述-视频-描述的往返过程进行测量。它们共同将下游文本记忆效用与事实和语义保留联系起来。

articles.title: Signals and Queries: Token-Efficient Agentic Context Discovery
articles.abstract: User-facing LLM agents must identify which behavioral policies apply at each turn, but evaluating every policy with an LLM is costly. We introduce Signals and Queries (S&Q), a lightweight first-stage relevance filter developed for Parlant 4.0 that removes at least 30% of candidate policies before downstream evaluation while preserving high recall. For each policy, an LLM generates activating examples and hard negatives offline. An independent logistic classifier trained on their embeddings then predicts relevance using embeddings and vector dot products, with no per-turn LLM calls. This shifts expensive relevance evaluation to a smaller candidate set, while allowing each policy's classifier to be updated independently. Evaluated against 9,144 LLM-judge relevance labels covering 254 $τ^2$-bench conversation prefixes and 36 airline policies, S&Q achieves higher precision than top-K and cosine-threshold retrieval at every evaluated recall level, with consistent results across two embedding providers. These findings support inexpensive, per-policy classification as a practical first stage for reducing downstream evaluation workload in customer-facing agents.
articles.titleCn: 信号与查询：基于令牌的高效代理式上下文发现
articles.abstractCn: 面向用户的LLM代理必须在每个回合中识别适用的行为策略，但使用LLM评估每个策略的成本很高。我们引入了信号与查询（S&Q），这是一种为Parlant 4.0开发的轻量级第一阶段相关性过滤器，它在保留高召回率的同时，在下游评估前移除了至少30%的候选策略。对于每个策略，LLM会离线生成激活示例和硬负样本。然后，一个基于这些嵌入训练的独立逻辑分类器使用嵌入和向量点积预测相关性，无需每个回合调用LLM。这将昂贵的相关性评估转移到较小的候选集中，同时允许每个策略的分类器独立更新。在涵盖254个$τ^2$-bench对话前缀和36个航空公司策略的9,144个LLM裁判相关性标签的评估中，S&Q在所有评估的召回率水平上均比top-K和余弦阈值检索实现了更高的精确度，并在两个嵌入提供者之间保持了稳定的结果。这些发现支持以低成本、按策略分类作为面向客户代理减少下游评估工作量的实用第一阶段。

articles.title: OSynth: A Longitudinal, Context-Sensitive Evaluation of Meeting Understanding
articles.abstract: Meeting notetakers are increasingly deployed in settings where longitudinal context is available including calendar metadata, prior meetings, emails, slides, and speaker enrollments; however, meeting corpora remain limited in terms of size, domain coverage, and available context. We present OSynth, a large-scale synthetic dataset of simulated organizations comprising 570 hours of meeting audio together with associated artifacts and a latent ground-truth state. In a pairwise comparison, human raters distinguish OSynth meetings from real meeting transcripts with only 56% accuracy based on excerpts of 150-300 words. Across state-of-the-art LLMs, additional context yields significant gains on several entity-sensitive dimensions, demonstrating limitations of contemporary approaches and the potential usefulness of OSynth in developing better-contextualized meeting-understanding systems.
articles.titleCn: OSynth：会议理解的纵向、情境敏感评估
articles.abstractCn: 随着纵向背景信息日益丰富的环境（包括日历元数据、过往会议、电子邮件、幻灯片和发言人登记信息）中越来越多地部署会议记录员，但会议语料库在规模、领域覆盖和可用背景信息方面仍然有限。我们提出了OSynth，一个大规模合成数据集，由模拟组织的570小时会议音频以及相关文档和潜在的真实状态组成。在两两比较中，人类评估员基于150-300字的片段，仅以56%的准确率区分OSynth会议和真实会议记录。在当前最先进的LLM中，额外背景信息在多个实体敏感维度上显著提升了性能，这表明了现有方法的局限性，并展示了OSynth在开发更注重背景信息的会议理解系统中的潜在价值。

articles.title: Asking What a Director Sees Can Change What Vision-Language Models Choose
articles.abstract: Vision-language models are now routinely tested on theory of mind: whether they can work out what another person sees, knows, and means. A common design asks the model to report that perspective and then to act for the person, and reads a correct report beside a wrong action as a failure to use the perspective. That reading rests on a quiet assumption: that asking for the report leaves the action unchanged. We show that it does not. In a rendered Director Task, a partition hides the largest block from a director who asks for "the largest block". Asking first which blocks the director can see raises the share of replies that choose this hidden block by 12 to 88 percentage points on six GPT models and by 17 on Qwen3.8-27B, even though the models mostly report correctly which blocks the director sees. Reasoning traces and prompt rewordings suggest why: the question shifts how the request is read, from the director's view toward the model's own. When the prompt states what the director knows and refers to, fewer than 1% of replies pair a correct report with a hidden-block choice. Any evaluation that elicits a perspective report before the action it scores needs a baseline without the question, and we deliver one: paired prompts that differ only in that question, a design any perspective-taking benchmark can adopt.
articles.titleCn: 询问导演看到的内容可以改变视觉语言模型的选择
articles.abstractCn: 当前，心智理论已成为对视觉语言模型的常规测试：它们能否推断出他人所看到、所知和所意的内容。一种常见的设计要求模型报告其视角，然后为该人采取行动，并将正确的报告与错误的行为读作未能使用该视角。这种解读基于一个隐含的假设：要求报告不会改变行为。我们证明这一假设并不成立。在一个渲染的导演任务中，一个分区会隐藏最大的积木，而向导演询问“最大的积木”时，该导演会看不见它。当我们首先询问导演能看到哪些积木时，在六个GPT模型上，选择这个隐藏积木的回复比例从12%提高到88%，在Qwen3.8-27B上提高了17%，尽管这些模型大多能正确报告导演看到的积木。推理追踪和提示重述表明原因：问题的提出改变了请求的解读方式，从导演的视角转向模型自身的视角。当提示声明导演所知和所指的是什么时，不到1%的回复将正确的报告与隐藏积木的选择配对。任何在评分行为之前要求模型提供视角报告的评估方法都需要一个不包含问题的基线，我们提供了一个：仅问题不同的配对提示，这种设计任何心智理论基准都可以采用。

articles.title: LLM-Based Exogenous World Modeling for Dynamic Scheduling
articles.abstract: Dynamic scheduling requires dispatching online arrivals while anticipating future jobs, as poor decisions can compound downstream costs under nonlinear tardiness objectives. We show that a pretrained large language model (LLM) can serve as the exogenous component of a structured world model, forecasting uncertain future job arrivals. Specifically, we exploit an afterstate decomposition, which separates known deterministic shop transitions from uncertain exogenous job arrivals, enabling the LLM to forecast only the latter through a compact belief representation. Building on this, we develop Afterstate World-Model Planning (AWMP), which combines an evolved, belief-conditioned dispatching strategy with short scenario-based rollouts. A surprise-triggered refresh mechanism queries the LLM only when newly observed arrivals deviate sufficiently from previous forecast, and online residual self-calibration further conditions the LLM on its recent forecast errors to handle nonstationary arrivals. Across diverse arrival distributions, AWMP reduces weighted tardiness by 6-21% on dynamic job-shop and 22-46% on flexible job-shop benchmarks, relative to the best of eight classical priority-dispatching rules.
articles.titleCn: 基于大型语言模型的动态调度外生世界建模
articles.abstractCn: 动态调度需要在处理在线到达的同时预测未来任务，因为在非线性的延迟目标下，糟糕的决策可能会加剧下游成本。我们证明，预训练的大型语言模型（LLM）可以作为结构化世界模型的外部组件，预测不确定的未来任务到达。具体而言，我们利用了后状态分解，将已知的确定性车间转换与不确定的外部任务到达分离，使LLM能够通过紧凑的信念表示仅预测后者。基于此，我们开发了后状态世界模型规划（AWMP），它结合了进化的、基于信念的调度策略和基于短场景的快速推进。一个意外触发的刷新机制仅在观察到的新到达显著偏离先前预测时才查询LLM，而在线残差自校准进一步基于LLM最近的预测误差来调整其处理非平稳到达。在多种到达分布下，与八种经典优先级调度规则的最好结果相比，AWMP在动态作业车间基准上减少了6-21%的加权延迟，在柔性作业车间基准上减少了22-46%。

articles.title: ExpEvolve: Structuring and Reusing Experience for Open-Ended Discovery
articles.abstract: Evolutionary coding agents such as AlphaEvolve are one of the notable successes in using Large Language Models (LLMs) to build AI Scientists. These agents tackle open-ended scientific problems by iteratively improving and evolving programs, leveraging the prior knowledge and reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Despite their success, mutations over programs are mostly low-level upon surface heuristics, without a persistent unit of control. In contrast, science compounds through ideas. In this work, we propose ExpEvolve, which injects idea-level extraction and control into evolution: it discovers and leverages the high-level factors from programs that explain scoring differences among different programs. We characterize theoretical conditions on when discovery with idea factors improves sample efficiency. We also build a practical framework to show that the extracted high-level idea factors are helpful for guiding exploitation from experience and exploration when discovery comes to a plateau. Across 11 open-ended mathematical tasks, ExpEvolve significantly improves the final performance and sample efficiency up to 5.0x. The improvements also transfer to 4 other LLMs and to 6 machine learning tasks from MLS-Bench. Analysis shows that ExpEvolve can discover idea-level factors to provide better exploration and exploitation for evolutionary discovery.
articles.titleCn: ExpEvolve：为开放式探索而构建和重用经验
articles.abstractCn: 进化编码代理（如AlphaEvolve）是利用大型语言模型（LLMs）构建AI科学家的一项显著成功。这些代理通过迭代改进和进化程序来处理开放式科学问题，并利用LLMs的先验知识和推理能力。尽管取得了成功，但程序中的突变主要基于表面启发式方法，缺乏持续的控制单元。相比之下，科学通过思想复合发展。在这项工作中，我们提出了ExpEvolve，它将思想层面的提取和控制注入进化过程：它发现并利用程序中解释不同程序得分差异的高级因素。我们描述了在何种情况下，利用思想因素进行发现可以提高样本效率的理论条件。我们还构建了一个实用框架，证明提取的高级思想因素在发现达到平台期时有助于指导从经验中利用和探索。在11个开放式数学任务中，ExpEvolve显著提高了最终性能和样本效率，最高可达5.0倍。这些改进也迁移到了其他4个LLMs和MLS-Bench的6个机器学习任务。分析表明，ExpEvolve能够发现思想层面的因素，为进化发现提供更好的探索和利用。

articles.title: Same Probabilities, Different Advice: Gain-Loss Framing Effects in High-Stakes LLM Decision Support
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support consequential decisions, yet their reliability under equivalent representations of uncertainty remains unclear. Existing work has documented prompt sensitivity, cognitive biases, and confidence miscalibration, but it is still unknown whether high-stakes advice changes when the same probability is expressed through complementary gain and loss frames. We introduce FrameBench-HPS, a controlled benchmark of 2,880 prompts derived from 240 high-stakes scenarios across healthcare, finance, education/career, and legal/consumer-rights domains. Across seven LLMs, gain-loss framing changes the recommendation category in 32.4% of complete groups, with most changes involving uncertainty rather than direct reversals. Human evaluation confirms corresponding shifts in perceived risk and directiveness. Robustness experiments show that framing effects persist under conversational paraphrases and exceed ordinary repeated-generation variability. Probability canonicalization substantially reduces framing sensitivity, identifying probability representation as a practical target for improving consistency in high-stakes LLM decision support.
articles.titleCn: 相同概率，不同建议：高风险LLM决策支持中的收益-损失框架效应
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于支持具有重大影响的决定，然而它们在不确定性等效表示下的可靠性尚不明确。现有研究已记录了提示敏感性、认知偏差和信心误校准，但尚不清楚当相同概率通过互补的收益和损失框架表达时，高风险建议是否会发生变化。我们引入了FrameBench-HPS，这是一个由240个高风险场景（涵盖医疗保健、金融、教育/职业和法律/消费者权利领域）衍生的2,880个提示的受控基准。在七个LLMs中，收益-损失框架改变了32.4%完整组的建议类别，其中大多数变化涉及不确定性而非直接反转。人类评估证实了感知风险和直接性的相应变化。鲁棒性实验表明，框架效应在对话释义下持续存在，并超过普通重复生成的变异性。概率规范化显著降低了框架敏感性，确定了概率表示为提高高风险LLM决策支持的连贯性的实用目标。

articles.title: Credit Where Credit Is Due: Contrastive Attribution Topology Search for Multi-Agent Systems
articles.abstract: An LLM multi-agent system (MAS) is only as good as the agents it chooses to trust: its accuracy and cost hinge on its topology, meaning which agents are included and how they communicate. A single task score, however, does not reveal which agents help or hinder performance. We propose Contrastive Attribution Topology Search (CATS), which searches for compact teams within a fixed supergraph of specialized agents. An LLM attributer compares execution traces across candidate topologies and assigns credit to individual agents. CATS uses these credits to update supergraph edges while progressively pruning weak edges and agents, yielding a small team for deployment. With small open-weight models and matched candidate evaluations, CATS improves mean accuracy on BigCodeBench by 5.3 percentage points over score-only heuristic search while using 54\% fewer deployment tokens. On MBPP, CATS matches the strongest baselines with fewer tokens than the other searches. In a HotpotQA prompt-poisoning stress test, CATS excludes all adversarially prompted agents in all three runs, whereas random search retains some at comparable accuracy. Per-agent credit thus supports both team optimization and the pruning of potentially harmful agents.
articles.titleCn: 功有所归：多智能体系统的对比归因拓扑搜索
articles.abstractCn: 一个LLM多智能体系统（MAS）的好坏取决于其选择的信任对象：其准确性和成本取决于拓扑结构，即包含哪些智能体以及它们如何通信。然而，单一任务分数并不能揭示哪些智能体有助于或阻碍性能。我们提出了对比归因拓扑搜索（CATS），该算法在固定的大型超图中搜索专业智能体的紧凑团队。一个LLM归因器比较候选拓扑中的执行轨迹，并将信用分配给单个智能体。CATS利用这些信用更新超图边，同时逐步修剪薄弱边和智能体，从而生成一个小型团队用于部署。使用小型开放权重模型和匹配的候选评估，CATS在BigCodeBench上的平均准确率比仅基于分数的启发式搜索提高了5.3个百分点，同时部署令牌使用量减少了54%。在MBPP上，CATS使用比其他搜索更少的令牌，达到了最强的基线水平。在HotpotQA提示中毒性压力测试中，CATS在三次运行中均排除了所有对抗性提示的智能体，而随机搜索在相当准确的情况下仍保留了部分智能体。因此，每个智能体的信用既支持团队优化，也支持修剪潜在有害的智能体。

articles.title: Computer Vision and Knowledge-Grounded Language Models for Intelligent Beekeeper Assistance
articles.abstract: Managed and wild bees sustain roughly a third of the global food products, yet colonies face mounting stress from climate-change including extreme weather patterns, altered parasite and disease patterns. Timely assessment of colony condition such as understanding colony strength, brood area, honey and pollen storage, comb usage, is essential to adaptive management. However, manual hive frame inspection is slow, costly, and quality depends on scarce expertise. We present an artificial targeted intelligent system framework focusing on edge deployable pipeline that turns hive frame photographs into interpretable and action-oriented inspection report. The pipeline includes an object detector to detect biologically-meaningful comb-cell classes; detections are distilled into structured fact schema; facts are converted into constrained factual text; the text triggers a grounded knowledge-base for interpretations and recommendations. Knowledge-base entries are required to be triggerable by evidence expressed in the fact schema. We built our system based on open source FAIRHiveFrames-1K dataset and favour reproducible, edge-deployable models over large general purpose frontier models. We additionally release FAIRHiveText-1K dataset that turns FAIRHiveFrames-1K dataset into interchangeable facts and text interpretation of the facts, making it easy for further LLM-based research into this area. We also propose a pathway to develop the grounded knowledge-base that will be helpful in providing interpretable and actionable reports from the facts.
articles.titleCn: 计算机视觉与知识基础语言模型在智能养蜂辅助中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 管理蜂和野生蜂维持着全球约三分之一的食品产品，但蜂群正面临气候变化带来的日益增长的压力，包括极端天气模式、寄生虫和疾病模式的改变。及时评估蜂群状况，如了解蜂群强度、幼虫区、蜂蜜和花粉储存、蜂巢使用情况，对于适应性管理至关重要。然而，人工蜂巢框检查速度慢、成本高，且质量取决于稀缺的专业知识。我们提出了一种基于边缘部署的管道的人工目标智能系统框架，将蜂巢框照片转化为可解释和行动导向的检查报告。该管道包括一个目标检测器，用于检测具有生物学意义的蜂巢细胞类别；检测结果被提炼为结构化事实模式；事实被转换为约束性事实文本；文本触发基于证据的知识库进行解释和建议。知识库条目必须能够被事实模式中表达的证据触发。我们的系统基于开源FAIRHiveFrames-1K数据集构建，更倾向于可复现、边缘部署的模型，而非大型通用前沿模型。我们额外发布了FAIRHiveText-1K数据集，将FAIRHiveFrames-1K数据集转化为可互换的事实和事实文本解释，便于进一步基于LLM的研究。我们还提出了一种开发基于证据触发知识库的路径，这将有助于从事实中提供可解释和可操作的报告。

articles.title: Heard But Not Said: Prompting Understates Temporal Information of Musical Moments in Frozen Large Audio-Language Models
articles.abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) understand music, yet struggle to locate a described moment in time. We ask whether this reflects missing temporal information or a bottleneck in how the time span is extracted. Using a paired-query probe built from Slakh2100 stem activations, we attach a state query (e.g., ``only piano and bass are playing'') and a change query (e.g., ``the guitar drops out, leaving piano and bass'') to the same span and vary how much preceding audio the model is shown. Across frozen LALMs, three ways of extracting the span ask different questions: full-track prompting asking whether the model can say when; windowed yes/no scoring asking whether it verifies the moment when handed the segment, and whether it needs what came before; attention asking whether it can find the moment on its own. State queries score above baseline without context, while change queries improve with preceding context in most short-segment models; 30s padded encoders show no comparable recovery. Prompting and attention expose almost none of this. Prompting failures thus understate what LALMs can verify, though not what they can locate, by an amount set by query type and encoder.
articles.titleCn: 听闻未言：提示词在冻结的大型音频语言模型中对音乐时刻的时间信息有所低估
articles.abstractCn: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）能够理解音乐，但在定位描述的时间点上却存在困难。我们探究这是否反映了缺失的时间信息，还是时间跨度提取过程中的瓶颈。我们使用基于Slakh2100主干激活构建的配对查询探针，将一个状态查询（例如，“只有钢琴和贝斯在演奏”）和一个变化查询（例如，“吉他退出，留下钢琴和贝斯”）附加到同一时间跨度上，并改变模型所展示的前置音频量。在冻结的LALMs中，三种提取时间跨度的方法提出了不同的问题：全轨提示询问模型能否说明时间；窗口式是/否评分询问模型在获得片段时能否验证时刻，以及是否需要前置信息；注意力机制询问模型能否自行找到时刻。状态查询在没有上下文的情况下得分高于基线，而变化查询在大多数短片段模型中随着前置上下文的增加而改进；30秒填充编码器则显示出无类似的恢复效果。提示和注意力机制几乎未揭示这些现象。因此，提示失败的程度上低估了LALMs能够验证的内容，尽管并未低估其定位能力，这个程度由查询类型和编码器决定。

articles.title: Hierarchical Masked Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Masked diffusion language models have emerged as an alternative to autoregressive models, enabling parallel token generation. However, standard masked diffusion language models use a shared noise schedule across positions without explicitly encoding which positions should be resolved first. Many tasks exhibit a natural priority among positions: document titles and section headings can guide the generation of body text, while Sudoku cells determined directly from the initial clues can help resolve more difficult cells. To incorporate this notion of priority (or hierarchy) among token positions, we introduce the Hierarchical Masked Diffusion Language Model (HMDLM), which augments each token position with a hierarchy level available as part of the training data, and requires zero or minimal additional annotations. It factors generation into two passes: the first predicts a hierarchy distribution over masked positions, the second predicts token distributions conditioned on it. Giving each hierarchy level its own noise schedule induces a soft, controllable preference for revealing higher-priority positions earlier while keeping decoding fully parallel. Our formulation is mathematically grounded, and we re-derive the forward and reverse processes and the NELBO for this factorization. Our evaluation shows that for the task of language generation on LM1B, HMDLM reduces perplexity by more than 1.5 points over Anchored Diffusion Language Model (ADLM), a recently proposed strong diffusion baseline; on WikiHow, we see a drop in perplexity of up to 4.4 pts on ADLM and up to 7 pts against MDLM. An LLM judge on WikiHow prefers HMDLM generations (the two variants combined) more than $2\times$ as often as the baseline. On the task of solving Sudoku puzzles requiring multi-step reasoning, it improves solution accuracy by up to $8.6\%$ absolute points over existing diffusion baselines.
articles.titleCn: 分层掩码扩散语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 掩码扩散语言模型已成为自回归模型的替代方案，能够并行生成标记。然而，标准的掩码扩散语言模型在各个位置使用共享的噪声调度，而没有明确编码哪些位置应优先解决。许多任务在位置之间存在自然的优先级：文档标题和章节标题可以指导正文内容的生成，而直接从初始线索中确定的数独单元格有助于解决更难的单元格。为了融入标记位置之间的优先级（或层级）概念，我们引入了层级掩码扩散语言模型（HMDLM），它为每个标记位置增加了层级级别，作为训练数据的一部分，且需要零或最小的额外标注。它将生成过程分为两个阶段：第一阶段预测掩码位置的层级分布，第二阶段基于该分布预测标记分布。为每个层级级别分配独立的噪声调度，可诱导出一种软的、可控的偏好，即在保持解码完全并行的情况下，优先揭示高优先级位置。我们的公式具有数学基础，并重新推导了该分解的前向和后向过程以及NELBO。我们的评估表明，在LM1B的语言生成任务上，HMDLM相较于最近提出的强扩散基线模型锚定扩散语言模型（ADLM），困惑度降低了1.5以上；在WikiHow上，我们观察到ADLM的困惑度降低了4.4，而MDLM降低了7。在WikiHow上，一个LLM裁判更喜欢HMDLM生成（两种变体合并）的次数是基线的两倍。在需要多步推理的数独求解任务上，它相较于现有的扩散基线模型，绝对提升了8.6%的求解准确率。

articles.title: Intergroup Bias Predicts Expressions of Social Judgment and Empathy in the r/AmITheAsshole Reddit Community
articles.abstract: People share and understand others' experiences differently based on their social identities; often, people empathize more when the other person belongs to their ingroup compared to an outgroup. While this intergroup empathy gap is well-studied in social psychology, it remains unclear how it manifests in naturally occurring online social interactions. To this end, we measure how commenters express social judgments, as an indirect outcome of their understanding towards the posters, and empathy in text, based on whether commenters share the poster's gender or are of similar ages. We focus on posts where the poster self-reports these demographics, and analyze 126,716 comments associated with 36,163 posts from 18,111 commenters in r/AmItheAsshole, while controlling for commenter and poster group identities, post features (topic, length, and score), and both commenter- and post-level variance. Our results show that when commenters and posters are ingroup, in either gender or age, commenters are more likely to provide a Not the Asshole verdict and show greater text-based understanding as measured by LLMs. We also observe that older commenters behave differently from younger ones. Furthermore, in a subset of posts where the gender and age of the other party in the conflict are explicitly mentioned, we find that commenter-poster ingroup effects are moderated by the group relationships between the poster and the other party when commenters make social judgments. Our work highlights the importance of intergroup context and social group nuances in understanding online discourse.
articles.titleCn: 群体偏见预测了r/AmITheAsshole Reddit社区中社会判断和共情的表达
articles.abstractCn: 人们根据其社会身份分享和理解他人经历的方式有所不同；通常，当对方属于他们的内群体时，人们比对方属于外群体时更能产生共情。虽然群体间共情差距在社会心理学中已被广泛研究，但其在自然发生的线上社交互动中的表现仍不明确。为此，我们测量评论者在理解发帖者时表达的社会评判（作为其理解程度的间接结果）和文本中的共情程度，并根据评论者是否与发帖者性别相同或年龄相似进行测量。我们专注于那些发帖者自我报告了这些人口统计信息的帖子，分析了来自r/AmItheAsshole的36,163个帖子中与18,111名评论者相关的126,716条评论，同时控制了评论者和发帖者的群体身份、帖子特征（主题、长度和评分）以及评论者和帖子层面的变异。我们的结果表明，当评论者和发帖者为内群体时（无论性别或年龄），评论者更有可能给出“不是混蛋”的评判，并且通过大型语言模型测量的文本理解程度更高。我们还观察到，年长评论者的行为与年轻评论者不同。此外，在冲突中另一方的性别和年龄明确提及的帖子子集中，我们发现当评论者做出社会评判时，评论者-发帖者内群体效应受到发帖者与另一方群体关系的影响。我们的研究强调了群体间背景和社会群体细微差别在理解线上话语中的重要性。

articles.title: Let Agents Design How They Search: Automatic Interface Optimization for Agentic Search
articles.abstract: Agentic search depends on the interface through which a language-model agent accesses and explores a corpus. Existing interface designs are fixed by hand and applied unchanged to every corpus, although effective designs may depend on the corpus. We introduce SearchWeaver, a framework for automatic search interface optimization guided by downstream search performance. A proposer uses execution trajectories and task rewards to jointly revise corpus artifacts, executable tools, and usage instructions. This pro cess optimizes what information is prepared in advance, which operations tools perform, and which decisions remain with the search agent. With GPT-5.4-nano, the optimized interfaces improve answer accuracy from 71.6% to 78.4% on BrowseComp-Plus and average nDCG@10 from 45.7 to 55.0 across four BRIGHT subsets over Direct Corpus Interaction. These findings highlight the value of jointly optimizing corpus artifacts, executable tools, and usage instructions to develop effective search interfaces.
articles.titleCn: 让代理设计其搜索方式：代理搜索的自动界面优化
articles.abstractCn: 基于代理的搜索依赖于语言模型代理访问和探索语料库的界面。现有的界面设计是人工固定的，并且未经更改地应用于每个语料库，尽管有效的设计可能取决于语料库。我们介绍了SearchWeaver，这是一个由下游搜索性能指导的自动搜索界面优化框架。一个提议者使用执行轨迹和任务奖励来共同修订语料库工件、可执行工具和使用说明。这个过程优化了预先准备的信息、工具执行的操作以及搜索代理保留的决策。使用GPT-5.4-nano，优化的界面在BrowseComp-Plus上将答案准确率从71.6%提高到78.4%，并在Direct Corpus Interaction上跨越四个BRIGHT子集将平均nDCG@10从45.7提高到55.0。这些发现突出了共同优化语料库工件、可执行工具和使用说明以开发有效搜索界面的价值。

articles.title: MOSAIC: An Omni-Modal Benchmark for Long-Term Memory and Cross-Modal Reasoning in Conversational Agents
articles.abstract: Omni-modal assistants must remember not only what users say, but also what they show and convey. Existing long-term memory benchmarks are mostly text-and-image or report a single end-to-end score, so they cannot locate whether evidence is lost when it is represented, retrieved, delivered, or read. We introduce MOSAIC, a benchmark of 923 questions over persona-grounded histories of 11-24 sessions spanning text, image, video, and audio. MOSAIC constructs targeted spatial, temporal, and prosodic signals rather than decorative media, with the strongest causal validation for spatial information and selector-level validation for annotated prosody, and pairs them with a matched diagnostic protocol that freezes the question, reader, prompt, and budget while intervening on representation, retrieval, and delivery. Matched decomposition shows that representation loss is modality-dependent, residual reading dominates even under gold evidence, and abstention remains weak on these controls: strong answerable scores coexist with failures to refuse. MOSAIC thus turns omni-modal memory evaluation from a leaderboard into a diagnosis of write, retrieve, deliver, and read failures.
articles.titleCn: MOSAIC：一个用于对话代理中长期记忆和跨模态推理的全模态基准
articles.abstractCn: 全模态助手不仅要记住用户所说的话，还要记住他们所展示和传达的内容。现有的长期记忆基准大多是文本和图像型，或者只报告单一端到端的分数，因此无法定位证据在表示、检索、传递或阅读过程中是否丢失。我们引入了MOSAIC，这是一个包含923个问题的基准，涵盖了跨越11-24个会话的文本、图像、视频和音频的基于角色的历史记录。MOSAIC构建了针对性的空间、时间和韵律信号，而不是装饰性媒体，其中空间信息具有最强的因果验证，标注韵律具有选择器级别的验证，并与一个匹配的诊断协议配对，该协议冻结了问题、读者、提示和预算，同时在表示、检索和传递上进行干预。匹配分解表明，表示损失是模态相关的，即使在有金证据的情况下，残余阅读仍然占主导地位，在这些控制上拒绝仍然较弱：强可回答分数与拒绝失败并存。因此，MOSAIC将全模态记忆评估从排行榜转变为对写入、检索、传递和阅读失败的诊断。

articles.title: Beyond Binary Labels: Diagnostic Evaluation of LLM Safety with Prompt-Level Rubrics
articles.abstract: Current LLM safety benchmarks predominantly rely on binary safe or unsafe labels, lacking explanatory depth and suffering from low consistency across automated judges. To address this, we introduce DiagSafe, a diagnostic evaluation framework that moves beyond binary classification by employing prompt-level rubrics. Grounded in globally applicable AI safety policies, each rubric provides explicit criteria along two dimensions: safety, which targets concrete harms with specific exemptions to suppress false positives, and usefulness, which independently evaluates instruction fulfillment. To ensure a robust and realistic evaluation, we construct a bilingual (English-Chinese) benchmark grounded in a comprehensive 84-label safety taxonomy, consisting of two subsets: DiagBase, which covers single- and multi-turn prompts with direct harmful queries and template-based jailbreaks, and DiagAttack, which embeds harmful intents into complex instruction-following tasks to form challenging instruction attacks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiagSafe significantly enhances the reliability of LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, achieving 95.34% agreement with human annotations -- substantially higher than the 69%-87% achieved by the baselines -- and high inter-judge consistency (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.864). Furthermore, applying our framework reveals that leading LLMs differ markedly in their unsafe rates, and each model also exhibits unique vulnerabilities along different dimensions. In addition, we observe that models are particularly susceptible in Chinese and multi-turn contexts. Ultimately, DiagSafe provides a reliable and explainable tool for auditing and optimizing LLM alignment.

articles.titleCn: 超越二元标签：基于提示级别评分标准的LLM安全诊断评估
articles.abstractCn: 当前的LLM安全基准主要依赖二元的“安全”或“不安全”标签，缺乏解释深度，且在自动评判者之间的一致性较低。为解决这一问题，我们引入了DiagSafe，这是一个超越二元分类的诊断评估框架，通过采用提示级别的评分标准。基于全球通用的AI安全政策，每个评分标准沿两个维度提供明确标准：安全性，针对具体危害并设有特定豁免以抑制误报；实用性，独立评估指令的履行情况。为确保评估的稳健性和真实性，我们构建了一个基于全面的84标签安全分类法的双语（英语-中文）基准，包含两个子集：DiagBase，涵盖单轮和多轮提示，包含直接的危害性查询和基于模板的越狱；DiagAttack，将危害性意图嵌入复杂的指令遵循任务中，形成具有挑战性的指令攻击。大量实验表明，DiagSafe显著提升了LLM作为评判者的评估可靠性，与人工标注的符合率达95.34%——远高于基线的69%-87%，并具有高度评判者间一致性（Cohen's $κ$ = 0.864）。此外，应用我们的框架揭示，领先的LLM在“不安全率”上存在显著差异，且每个模型在不同维度上也表现出独特的脆弱性。此外，我们观察到模型在中文和多轮语境中尤其易受攻击。最终，DiagSafe为审计和优化LLM对齐提供了可靠且可解释的工具。

articles.title: C$^2$U in RAG: Compositional Concept Unlearning in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation can expose unwanted concepts through retrieved evidence even when the generator is moderated. We study query-side concept suppression with a fixed encoder and document index. Compositional Concept Unlearning (C$^2$U) routes a profile-derived direction through an augmented atom bank, adding only a bounded edited-minus-original delta to the raw query. Across five datasets, four encoders, and three seeds, the validation-selected configuration reduces pooled binary target Hit@5 by 4.25 percentage points with non-positive control degradation and target-exposure changes. Under the evaluated query transforms, it suppresses target density without increasing budgeted control-query exposure. Separately, ArXiv four-concept composition improves over an averaged-direction comparator after independent validation gates and first-use test evaluation.
articles.titleCn: C$^2$U在RAG：检索增强生成中的组合概念去学习
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成即使在生成器经过审核的情况下，也可能通过检索到的证据暴露不希望出现的概念。我们研究了固定编码器和文档索引的查询端概念抑制方法。组合概念去学习（C$^2$U）通过增强原子库将基于配置文件的导向路由，仅向原始查询添加有限的编辑减去原始的差值。在五个数据集、四个编码器和三个种子上，验证选择的配置将池化二元目标Hit@5降低了4.25个百分点，同时非正向控制退化且目标暴露变化。在评估的查询转换下，它抑制了目标密度而不增加预算控制查询的暴露。另外，ArXiv四概念组合在独立验证门和首次使用测试评估后，优于平均方向比较器。

articles.title: Preference Is Not Permission: Personalizing the Auto-Purchase Line in Agentic Commerce
articles.abstract: Personalized shopping benchmarks ask which item fits the user; we ask how far an agent may commit on that item, and pose learning the individual's auto-purchase line as a task. The boundary is evidence-conditioned and three-valued: whether committing is appropriate depends on the sufficiency of product information (warrant), reversibility, price against the user's norm, and urgency, not only on fit; and the natural output is don't buy, confirm first, or buy automatically. Across sixteen instruction-tuned models, autonomous commitment is misaligned with a human authorization reference in which fifteen annotators, role-playing the delegating principal from a given profile, choose the furthest action they would allow without confirmation: models commit even when fit is low and when their own evidence flag reports the warrant missing. This is overreach. The line is individual: these raters disagree, yet the disagreement is structured and partly predictable from a person's own other labels. A shallow learner on a few dozen of a person's own labels predicts their held-out auto-purchase line at a median of 0.79 by 30-40 labels, outperforming every evaluated prompt$\times$model configuration, including a per-annotator oracle over 80 configurations; the learned boundary does not transfer across domains. We release the counterfactual benchmark, human authorization reference, and annotation protocol after acceptance.
articles.titleCn: 偏好并非许可：在自主式商业中个性化自动购买线
articles.abstractCn: 个性化购物基准旨在确定哪件商品适合用户；我们则探究智能体可以在这件商品上做出多大程度的承诺，并将学习个人的自动购买界限作为一项任务。界限是证据条件化的，具有三值性：是否做出承诺是否恰当取决于产品信息的充分性（担保）、可逆性、价格是否符合用户规范以及紧迫性，而不仅仅是匹配度；自然输出为不购买、先确认或自动购买。在十六个指令微调模型中，自主承诺与人类授权参考不一致，其中十五个标注者扮演从给定资料中指定的授权主体角色，选择他们在不经确认的情况下允许采取的最远行动：模型即使匹配度低且其自身证据标记报告担保缺失时也会做出承诺。这是越权行为。界限是个体化的：这些评分者意见不一，但分歧具有结构化特征，且部分可从个人的其他标签中预测。一个基于几十个个人标签的浅层学习器，通过30-40个标签就能预测其保留的自动购买界限，准确率中位数为0.79，优于所有评估的提示符×模型配置，包括超过80个配置的每个标注者或acles；所学习的界限无法跨领域迁移。我们在接受后发布了反事实基准、人类授权参考和标注协议。

articles.title: Understanding Target Probability Reuse in Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Speculative decoding uses a target model to verify a tree of draft tokens in parallel. We study whether the resulting next-token distributions can help select the next tree. For unrestricted target models, we show that guaranteed exact reuse requires a distribution computed at the next round's complete context. We characterize when retaining this distribution requires sacrificing accepted tokens and establish conditions under which this loss persists across decoding rounds. Across six targets, we find that reranking first-token branches with a separately computed distribution at the current context improves expected acceptance over draft ranking, especially with small tree budgets. Drawing the first token from this distribution before allocating the tree further improves expected acceptance over pruning a preselected tree, even at equal mean tree size. In our experiments, both selection rules also decode faster than draft ranking when the separate target pass overlaps standalone drafting. Our findings show that making target probabilities available before tree allocation can improve the efficiency of speculative decoding. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/TargetRows.
articles.titleCn: 理解推测解码中的目标概率重用
articles.abstractCn: 推测解码使用目标模型并行验证草稿标记的树。我们研究了生成的下一个标记分布是否有助于选择下一个树。对于无限制的目标模型，我们证明保证精确重用需要一个在下一轮完整上下文中计算的分布。我们描述了保留该分布需要牺牲接受的标记的情况，并建立了这种损失在解码轮次中持续的条件。在六个目标模型中，我们发现使用当前上下文中单独计算的分布重新排序第一个标记分支，比草稿排序能提高预期接受率，尤其是在树预算较小的情况下。在分配树之前从该分布中获取第一个标记，比修剪预选树能进一步提高预期接受率，即使平均树大小相同。在我们的实验中，当单独的目标传递与独立草稿绘制重叠时，这两种选择规则解码速度也比草稿排序更快。我们的研究表明，在树分配之前提供目标概率可以提高推测解码的效率。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/js-lee-AI/TargetRows 获取。

articles.title: norregel: a preregistered benchmark of dated numeric values in Norwegian law
articles.abstract: norregel asks language models for numeric values in Norwegian statutes, regulations and parliamentary decisions (NOK amounts, percentages, multiples of the National Insurance basic amount (G) and age limits), each at a stated date. The 916 items were extracted mechanically from Lovdata's open data, and each carries the dated history of its provision, so an answer can be classed as correct, outdated, wrong or uninterpretable. We report a first and a second preregistered run on the same items. In the first run (five models, listed publicly only after local analysis), H1, that outdated answers are more frequent for values that took effect after a model's cutoff, could not be tested in substance, and H2 and H3 were inconclusive; Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 4.6 answered 46.7% and 40.2% of the 880 primary items correctly. The second run was preregistered and published before any of its calls, and eight models were analysed. Its pooled primary test supported H1 under the preregistered decision rule (d = 17.8 percentage points, 95% interval [7.7, 28.9], p = 0.0001). In the preregistered sensitivity analysis S8, which counts as outdated only the most recent value that differs from the key, d was 3.9 [-3.6, 12.7] (p = 0.1754), an interval that contains 0. H1 was supported in every other preregistered sensitivity analysis, but S8 is the only one that gives both groups one target value, so we do not regard the support for H1 as robust. The share of outdated answers equal to that most recent value (H2) was 56.1% [46.6, 65.0], an interval that contains 0.5, and the pooled test of a lower share correct in Nynorsk than in Bokmål (H3) was inconclusive. Several models, among them Haiku 4.5, gave mostly uninterpretable answers. Items and keys are withheld; item IDs, per-answer classes, code and results are on Zenodo.
