articles.titleCn: 挪威法律中预先注册的日期数值基准测试
articles.abstractCn: norregel 向语言模型查询挪威法规、条例和议会决议中的数值（挪威克朗金额、百分比、国家保险基本金额（G）的倍数和年龄限制），每个数值均在特定日期提出。从 Lovdata 的开放数据中机械提取了 916 个条目，每个条目都带有其规定的日期历史记录，因此答案可以被分类为正确、过时、错误或不解。我们报告了针对同一条目的第一次和第二次预先注册的运行。在第一次运行（五个模型，仅在本地分析后公开列出）中，H1（过时答案对于在模型截止日期后生效的值更频繁）无法实质性检验，H2 和 H3 的结果也不确定；Opus 5.5 和 Sonnet 4.6 正确回答了 880 个初始条目的 46.7% 和 40.2%。第二次运行在分析任何调用之前预先注册并发布，分析了八个模型。其合并初始测试在预先注册的决策规则下支持 H1（d = 17.8 个百分点，95% 区间 [7.7, 28.9]，p = 0.0001）。在预先注册的敏感性分析 S8 中（仅将最新与关键值不同的值视为过时），d 为 3.9 [-3.6, 12.7]（p = 0.1754），该区间包含 0；H1 在其他所有预先注册的敏感性分析中都得到支持，但 S8 是唯一为两组提供同一目标值的分析，因此我们认为对 H1 的支持并不稳健。过时答案的比例等于该最新值（H2）为 56.1% [46.6, 65.0]，该区间包含 0.5，而 Nynorsk 正确答案比例低于 Bokmål 的合并测试（H3）结果不确定。几个模型（包括 Haiku 4.5）主要给出了解释性答案。条目和关键值被保留；条目 ID、每答案分类、代码和结果在 Zenodo 上公开。

articles.title: Reasoning-Search-Augmented LLMs: An Operational Taxonomy, Benchmark Analysis and Controlled Evidence Synthesis
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive emergent reasoning capabilities, yet they remain constrained by fixed model parameters and finite context windows. Even when augmented with static retrieval, they can produce statements that are unsupported by, or even contradictory to, retrieved evidence. This leads to hallucinations, difficulty incorporating up-to-date information, and failures to correctly interpret or reconcile sources. Recent work addresses these limitations by tightly coupling step-by-step reasoning with interactive search, treating retrieval as an action within an iterative agentic loop rather than a one-shot preprocessing step. This study reviews frameworks that implement such reasoning-search loops by interleaving planning, querying, retrieval, integration, verification, and stopping. We analyze these systems through four architectural axes: retrieval coupling, controller design, knowledge source, and grounding strictness. We separately treat the learning signal as a cross-cutting dimension because prompting, supervision, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning can instantiate the same architecture while producing materially different search, stopping, and grounding behavior. We further distinguish benchmark difficulty from RSA-loop demand and synthesize controlled within-study ablations and quality-cost deltas, avoiding invalid pooling across heterogeneous model backbones, retrievers, corpora, and evaluation protocols. Our goal is to clarify the landscape of reasoning-search-augmented LLMs and outline a unified perspective on the design choices shaping future research.
articles.titleCn: 推理搜索增强型大语言模型：一种操作分类法、基准分析及受控证据综合
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出令人印象深刻的涌现推理能力，但它们仍受限于固定的模型参数和有限的上下文窗口。即使在使用静态检索增强的情况下，它们也可能生成与检索证据不符甚至相矛盾的说法。这导致了幻觉现象、难以整合最新信息，以及无法正确解释或调和信息来源的问题。近期研究通过将逐步推理与交互式搜索紧密结合来解决这些限制，将检索视为迭代智能体循环中的一个动作，而非一次性预处理步骤。本研究回顾了通过交替规划、查询、检索、整合、验证和停止来实现此类推理-搜索循环的框架。我们通过四个架构维度分析这些系统：检索耦合、控制器设计、知识来源和接地严格性。我们将学习信号作为跨维度处理，因为提示、监督、偏好优化和强化学习可以实例化相同的架构，同时产生实质上不同的搜索、停止和接地行为。我们进一步区分基准难度与RSA循环需求，并综合研究内控制实验和质成本差值，避免在异构模型骨干、检索器、语料库和评估协议之间进行无效的聚合。我们的目标是阐明推理-搜索增强LLMs的格局，并勾勒出塑造未来研究设计选择的统一视角。

articles.title: LTEM: LLM-Friendly Table-Enhanced Markdown for Table Understanding and Generation
articles.abstract: Tables in real-world documents, including scientific papers, financial reports, and statistical summaries, frequently use merged cells, multi-level headers, and sectioned layouts. Yet the lightweight formats LLMs handle best (Markdown, CSV) cannot express these structures, while expressive formats (HTML, LaTeX) impose excessive token cost and parsing complexity. To enable systematic analysis of this trade-off, we introduce a taxonomy decomposing table structure into six atomic features (F1-F6) and corresponding complexity levels (L1-L6), and construct STB (Synthetic Table Benchmark), a controlled benchmark with 1,089 tables systematically distributed across complexity levels. Using this framework, we propose LTEM (LLM-friendly Table-Enhanced Markdown), a formally specified, minimal extension of Markdown that explicitly encodes spans and hierarchical headers. Experiments across five state-of-the-art LLMs show that LTEM achieves accuracy comparable to HTML, offers a favorable accuracy-token trade-off relative to HTML and LaTeX, and produces substantially fewer invalid responses than LaTeX; for table generation, LTEM is comparable to MultiMarkdown though HTML is best. We release our taxonomy, benchmark, and format specification to support future research on LLM-table interaction.
articles.comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
articles.titleCn: LTEM：面向大型语言模型的表格增强型Markdown，用于表格理解和生成
articles.abstractCn: 现实世界文档中的表格，包括科学论文、财务报告和统计摘要，经常使用合并单元格、多级表头和分节布局。然而，LLM（大型语言模型）最能处理的轻量级格式（如Markdown、CSV）无法表达这些结构，而表达能力强的格式（如HTML、LaTeX）则会产生过高的token成本和解析复杂度。为了系统性地分析这种权衡，我们引入了一种分类法，将表格结构分解为六个原子特征（F1-F6）及其对应的复杂度级别（L1-L6），并构建了STB（合成表格基准），这是一个在复杂度级别上系统分布的1,089个表格的受控基准。基于此框架，我们提出了LTEM（LLM友好的表格增强Markdown），这是一种形式化指定的Markdown最小扩展，明确编码了跨度和分层表头。在五个最先进的LLM上的实验表明，LTEM实现了与HTML相当的准确度，相对于HTML和LaTeX提供了有利的准确度- token权衡，并且产生的无效响应远少于LaTeX；对于表格生成，LTEM与MultiMarkdown相当，尽管HTML最佳。我们发布了我们的分类法、基准和格式规范，以支持未来关于LLM-表格交互的研究。

articles.title: TrainBridge: Agentic NPU Training Optimization Guided by GPU Compilation Evidence
articles.abstract: We study how to improve training efficiency on Ascend NPUs. In the NPU training programs we study, framework-level compilation optimizations such as operator fusion are only partially applied, leaving fragmented computation and avoidable execution overheads. Profiling-guided tuning can address these inefficiencies, but it often requires costly trial and error. To make training on NPUs more efficient, we propose TrainBridge, an agentic approach for transferring GPU optimization guidance to NPU training. TrainBridge uses the highly optimized execution produced by mature GPU compilation stacks as a task-specific reference for NPU tuning. It extracts optimization intents from the GPU training execution to guide NPU program rewrites and further refines the rewritten program through iterative profiling. Our GPU-to-NPU migration experiments show that TrainBridge achieves an average 1.7x speedup across four workloads covering LLM pretraining, image classification, and vision-language training, and an average speedup of nearly 2.0x across 27 Modded-NanoGPT speedrun records with highly optimized GPU implementations.
articles.titleCn: TrainBridge：基于GPU编译证据的自主NPU训练优化
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了如何在Ascend NPU上提高训练效率。在我们研究的NPU训练程序中，框架级的编译优化（如算子融合）仅部分应用，留下了碎片化计算和可避免的执行开销。基于性能分析的自适应调优可以解决这些低效问题，但通常需要昂贵的试错。为了使NPU上的训练更加高效，我们提出了TrainBridge，这是一种将GPU优化指导迁移到NPU训练的智能方法。TrainBridge利用成熟的GPU编译栈产生的优化执行作为NPU调优的特定任务参考。它从GPU训练执行中提取优化意图，以指导NPU程序重写，并通过迭代性能分析进一步优化重写的程序。我们的GPU到NPU迁移实验表明，TrainBridge在涵盖LLM预训练、图像分类和视觉语言训练的四个工作负载上实现了平均1.7倍的加速，并在27条具有高度优化GPU实现的Modded-NanoGPT速跑记录中实现了近2.0倍的加速。

articles.title: TeachBack: Learning to Teach via Bidirectional Preference Optimization for On-Policy Self-Distillation
articles.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enables a language model to learn from a Teacher instantiated from the same model but given access to privileged information, such as a reference solution. We find that access to sufficient privileged information allows the Teacher to generate highly accurate trajectories; however, accuracy alone does not guarantee that these trajectories are suitable for Student learning. Direct access to a complete solution may encourage shortened, reference-conditioned derivations that omit the exploration, verification, and self-correction required to solve problems without privileged information. We introduce TeachBack, a bidirectional preference-learning framework for on-policy self-distillation that learns not only from the Teacher but also how the Teacher should teach. TeachBack shapes the Teacher's generation behavior by controlling the length of the reference-reasoning suffix injected into the prompt and by varying the prompt style. While maintaining comparable Teacher accuracy, it encourages the Teacher to explore and re-solve problems, thereby reducing its reliance on the reference solution. At each rollout refresh, the shared policy generates both a privileged Teacher trajectory and a problem-only Student trajectory. A pairwise preference objective uses privileged Teacher trajectories to improve Student learning, while the reversed preference uses the Student's behavior to shape future Teacher supervision under the privileged condition. Experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning tasks show that TeachBack consistently improves Student performance over existing OPSD methods and related baselines.
articles.titleCn: TeachBack：通过双向偏好优化进行策略内自我蒸馏的教学学习
articles.abstractCn: 基于策略的自蒸馏（OPSD）使语言模型能够从由同一模型实例化但获得特权信息的教师那里学习，例如参考解决方案。我们发现，获得足够的特权信息允许教师生成高度准确的轨迹；然而，准确性本身并不能保证这些轨迹适合学生学习。直接访问完整解决方案可能会鼓励缩短的、参考条件下的推导，从而省略了在没有特权信息的情况下解决问题所需的探索、验证和自我纠正。我们引入了TeachBack，这是一个用于基于策略自蒸馏的双向偏好学习框架，它不仅从教师那里学习，还学习教师应该如何教学。TeachBack通过控制注入到提示中的参考推理后缀的长度和改变提示风格来塑造教师的生成行为。在保持相当教师准确性的同时，它鼓励教师探索和重新解决问题，从而减少其对参考解决方案的依赖。在每个滚动刷新中，共享策略生成一个特权教师轨迹和一个仅包含问题的学生轨迹。一个成对偏好目标使用特权教师轨迹来改进学生学习，而反向偏好则使用学生的行为来塑造未来在特权条件下的教师监督。在数学和逻辑推理任务上的实验表明，TeachBack始终比现有的OPSD方法和相关基线提高了学生的表现。

articles.title: Carving Radiology Reports at Their Evidential Joints: Anatomical Region Sets as Generation Units
articles.abstract: Organizing radiology reports into independently generated units offers a way to generate fine-grained clinical content and bind it to visual evidence. However, existing methods typically adopt generation-unit structures not directly specified in natural reports or their annotations, introducing additional modeling compromises. We propose RadCarve, which instead defines generation units directly from the anatomical region sets in existing statement-region correspondences, unifying unit formation with visual evidence selection. RadCarve's planner uses composition-specialized query banks to jointly predict unit existence and region composition from the image, iteratively refining both with regional evidence aggregated according to current membership predictions. The generator independently produces each unit's text conditioned on the joint visual evidence of its predicted region set. Compared with strong baselines, RadCarve improves CXRFEScore by 9.4% in unit generation given region sets and achieves 2.4 times the end-to-end binding F1. It also achieves leading report-generation results on Chest ImaGenome and PadChest-GR, using fewer than one-sixth as many parameters as large-scale baselines.
articles.titleCn: 在放射学报告的证据关节处雕刻：解剖区域集作为生成单元
articles.abstractCn: 将放射科报告组织成独立生成的单元，提供了一种生成细粒度临床内容并将其与视觉证据相结合的方法。然而，现有方法通常采用在自然报告或其注释中未直接指定的生成单元结构，从而引入了额外的建模妥协。我们提出了RadCarve，它直接从现有的陈述区域对应关系中的解剖区域集中定义生成单元，将单元形成与视觉证据选择统一。RadCarve的规划器使用专门针对组合的查询库，从图像中联合预测单元存在性和区域组成，并迭代地使用根据当前成员预测聚合的区域证据来优化两者。生成器独立地根据其预测区域集的联合视觉证据生成每个单元的文本。与强基线相比，RadCarve在给定区域集的单元生成方面将CXRFEScore提高了9.4%，并实现了2.4倍的端到端绑定F1。它还在Chest ImaGenome和PadChest-GR上实现了领先的报告生成结果，使用的参数数量仅为大规模基线不到六分之一。

articles.title: Why is AI-generated language so hard to understand?
articles.abstract: There is a widespread sense that AI-generated text has recently become harder to understand. In this study, we investigate a set of psycholinguistic features that are known to correlate with human processing difficulty (e.g., object relative clauses, long syntactic dependencies, low-frequency n-grams). Using a novel corpus of AI-generated text across diverse domains, we find that AI models use these difficult features more often than paraphrases generated by round-trip translation. Compared with human writing, all nine frontier and near-frontier models use more inanimate subjects with animate verbs and more low-frequency n-grams, and most also use longer dependencies, more stacked nouns, and more reduced object relatives in conversation; we also demonstrate substantial variation across model families. We propose and test a hypothesis as to why: while human language is optimized for successful communication, AI-generated text is increasingly optimized for other goals like math, code, and reasoning, in which there is a pressure for \textit{information density} rather than successful communication. We provide a proof-of-concept for this hypothesis by fine-tuning a language model under a length penalty, which leads to a divergence from human-like linguistic behavior. Our findings highlight the axes of misalignment between linguistic processing demands in humans and LLMs, and point toward possible remedies.
articles.titleCn: 为什么人工智能生成的语言如此难以理解？
articles.abstractCn: 人们普遍认为，近年来人工智能生成的文本变得越来越难以理解。在本研究中，我们调查了一组已知与人类处理难度相关的心理语言特征（例如，宾语从句、长句法依赖、低频n-gram）。利用一个涵盖不同领域的新型人工智能生成文本语料库，我们发现人工智能模型使用这些困难特征比通过往返翻译生成的释义更为频繁。与人类写作相比，所有九种前沿和近前沿模型都使用了更多无生命主语搭配有生命动词以及更多低频n-gram，大多数模型还使用了更长的依赖关系、更多堆叠名词以及更多省略宾语从句的对话；我们还展示了不同模型家族之间的显著差异。我们提出并验证了一个假设来解释这一现象：虽然人类语言是为了成功的交流而优化的，但人工智能生成的文本正越来越多地为了数学、代码和推理等目标而优化，在这些目标中，压力在于信息密度而非成功的交流。我们通过在长度惩罚下微调语言模型，为这一假设提供了一个概念验证，这导致了与类人语言行为的偏离。我们的研究突出了人类语言处理需求与大型语言模型之间错位的关键维度，并指出了可能的改进方向。

articles.title: VeeReview: Measuring Build-Verify Pairs in Agent-Authored Pull Requests from a V-Model Perspective
articles.abstract: Context: Reviewing a pull request requires verification evidence that addresses the proposed change. Coding agent benchmarks and studies of pull request outcomes do not directly assess this relationship. Objective: We test whether the V-Model's build and verify pairs can measure verification evidence in pull requests and support comparisons between agent-authored and human-authored changes. Method: VeeReview classifies four build and verify pairs using repository signals and a language-model judge. Three pairs use model judgements constrained by deterministic signals, and a rule over the diff and repository tree decides Module Design-Unit Test. We evaluated VeeReview against a 25-pull request reference set labelled by two raters and applied it to 1,454 matched pairs of agent and human pull requests from 741 repositories. Results: VeeReview assigned lower build-only rates to agent-authored pull requests on all four pairs, contrary to the preregistered hypothesis (mixed-effects odds ratios 0.52 to 0.86). Architecture-Integration was not significant. Standardization for linked issues, shipped tests and size reduced matched-rate differences by 34% to 60%, and the rule-decided pair's standardized interval included zero. The instrument did not meet its preregistered calibration criterion: agreement with adjudicated labels was 4% to 60% against a required 80%, and inter-rater agreement was weak (kappa = 0.154). Conclusions: The rule-decided pair shows that a process measure judged by a language model partly reflects how a pull request is presented rather than the verification work behind it. We report the cohort differences as observations made with this instrument, and we argue that such measures need a mechanically decided component and a validated human reference before they can support comparisons of verification practice.

articles.titleCn: VeeReview：从V模型视角测量代理认证的拉取请求中的构建验证对
articles.abstractCn: 背景：审查拉取请求需要验证证据来支持所提议的变更。编码代理基准测试和拉取请求结果的研究并不能直接评估这种关系。目标：我们测试V模型中的构建和验证对是否能够衡量拉取请求中的验证证据，并支持对代理编写和人类编写的变更进行比较。方法：VeeReview使用仓库信号和语言模型裁判对四组构建和验证对进行分类。其中三组使用受确定性信号约束的模型判断，而一个规则基于diff和仓库树决定模块设计-单元测试。我们使用两个裁判标记的25个拉取请求参考集评估了VeeReview，并将其应用于来自741个仓库的1,454对匹配的代理和人类拉取请求。结果：VeeReview在四组中都将代理编写的拉取请求的构建仅率评定为较低，与预先注册的假设相反（混合效应优势比0.52至0.86）。架构-集成没有显著差异。关联问题、已发布的测试和规模的标准化将匹配率差异减少了34%至60%，而规则决定的对的标准化区间包含零。该工具未达到其预先注册的校准标准：与裁决标签的一致性为4%至60%，而要求达到80%，且裁判间一致性较弱（kappa = 0.154）。结论：规则决定的对表明，由语言模型评判的过程指标部分反映了拉取请求的呈现方式，而非其背后的验证工作。我们报告了使用该工具观察到的队列差异，并认为此类指标在支持验证实践比较之前，需要包含机械决定的成分和经过验证的人类参考。

articles.title: GRAFT: Restoring the Missing Sampling Interface in Continuous Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Continuous diffusion language models generate a whole sequence in parallel, never drawing a single word at any intermediate step; only the final step turns embeddings into text. Models such as ELF now report autoregressive-level quality at a fraction of the sampling steps of discrete-token diffusion models, and this design principle -- no step-wise discretization -- is what their own ablations credit for the gain. We show that this same principle carries a hidden cost: a collapse of the lexical long tail. Measured against held-out human text, ELF's output matches the human rate on common words almost exactly, yet its rarest words appear at only 0.30x the human rate, a gap that does not close from 105M to 652M parameters and that no sampler setting these models expose can reach. A same-size GPT-2, in contrast, spans zero to above the human rate by its decoding rule alone. We trace the difference to what continuous diffusion models lack: with no step that ever draws a discrete word, every step is instead driven by an average over the candidates still in play, and averaging a rare candidate together with the common word competing for its slot lands on the common word. An autoregressive model avoids this because its decoding rule samples one candidate rather than averaging over all of them. We propose GRAFT, a training-free method that grafts this missing choice back onto a frozen model: while the model is still undecided, GRAFT commits the rare words the average would otherwise discard, then regenerates the sequence from scratch with those commitments held in place. Across three ELF scales and on LangFlow, an independent continuous dLLM, GRAFT restores the rare-word share of generated text from 0.42-0.77x the human rate to 0.82-1.10x, a relative gain of 34-109%, and moves the entire word-frequency profile closer to human on every model tested, by 2.7x on ELF-B and 12x on LangFlow.
articles.titleCn: 嫁接：在连续扩散语言模型中恢复缺失的采样接口
articles.abstractCn: 连续扩散语言模型并行生成整个序列，在任何中间步骤都不抽取单个词；只有最终步骤将嵌入转换为文本。像ELF这样的模型现在在离散标记扩散模型的采样步骤的一小部分上报告了自回归级别的质量，而其设计原则——无逐步离散化——正是其消融实验归因于收益的原因。我们表明，这一相同的原则隐藏着成本：词汇长尾的崩溃。与保留的人类文本相比，ELF的输出在常见词上几乎完全匹配人类速率，但其最罕见的词仅出现于人类速率的0.30倍，这一差距从1.05亿到6.52亿参数之间并未缩小，且没有任何采样设置可以暴露这些模型达到这一水平。相比之下，相同规模的GPT-2仅通过其解码规则就跨越了从零到高于人类速率的范围。我们将差异归因于连续扩散模型所缺乏的东西：由于没有任何步骤会抽取离散词，每一步都是由仍在竞争中的候选词的平均值驱动的，将罕见词与竞争其位置的常见词平均会导致结果落在常见词上。自回归模型避免了这个问题，因为其解码规则从一个候选词中采样而不是对所有候选词进行平均。我们提出了GRAFT，这是一种无训练方法，它将这种缺失的选择重新嫁接到冻结的模型上：当模型尚未确定时，GRAFT将罕见词提交给平均值原本会丢弃的部分，然后保持这些承诺不变，从头开始重新生成序列。在三个ELF规模和LangFlow（一个独立的连续dLLM）上，GRAFT将生成文本中罕见词的比例从人类速率的0.42-0.77倍提升到0.82-1.10倍，相对收益为34-109%，并通过在所有测试模型上使整个词频分布更接近人类，在ELF-B上提升2.7倍，在LangFlow上提升12倍。

articles.title: GRAM: Group-wise Rank-Aware Model Merging via Subspace Alignment
articles.abstract: Merging different models into a single model is highly desirable for multi-task deployment, particularly in regulated domains like healthcare. In such settings, models are often locally fine-tuned due to strict data privacy policies, necessitating that aggregation operates exclusively on the fine-tuned weights. Existing methods apply a uniform merge across all tasks, ignoring the geometric relationships among their learned subspaces. When task updates occupy misaligned subspaces, projecting them onto a shared low-rank basis discards task-relevant directions, a failure mode named \emph{subspace interference}. Through this study, we show that the per-task projection error of a merged model is governed by the principal-angle alignment between each task and the shared subspace, so that grouping geometrically compatible tasks provably reduces this error within each group. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{Group-wise Rank-Aware Model Merging (GRAM)}, which uses the principal-angle geometry of task vectors to decide which tasks should be merged together and then performs a standard SVD-based merge within each coalition; the pipeline requires only the fine-tuned weights at merge time. With only one additional model ($\nK{=}2$), GRAM significantly mitigates subspace interference and consistently outperforms prior merging methods across language understanding (GLUE with Flan-T5), 8-task CLIP vision, and medical instruction tuning (Qwen2-7B-Instruct with four English/Chinese medical LoRAs).
articles.titleCn: 基于子空间对齐的组内排序感知模型合并方法：GRAM
articles.abstractCn: 将不同模型整合为单一模型对于多任务部署尤其具有吸引力，特别是在医疗保健等受监管领域。在这样的环境中，由于严格的数据隐私政策，模型通常需要本地微调，因此聚合操作必须仅针对微调后的权重进行。现有方法对所有任务应用统一的合并，忽略了它们学习到的子空间之间的几何关系。当任务更新占据错位的子空间时，将它们投影到共享的低秩基上会丢弃与任务相关的方向，这种失效模式被称为“子空间干扰”。通过这项研究，我们表明合并模型的每项任务投影误差受每个任务与共享子空间之间主角对齐的支配，因此将几何兼容的任务分组可以证明在每组内减少这种误差。基于这一观察，我们提出了“基于组的秩感知模型合并（GRAM）”，该算法利用任务向量的主角几何形状来决定哪些任务应该合并在一起，然后在每个联盟内执行标准的基于SVD的合并；该流程在合并时仅需微调后的权重。仅增加一个额外的模型（$\nK{=}2$），GRAM显著减轻了子空间干扰，并在语言理解（使用Flan-T5的GLUE）、8任务CLIP视觉和医疗指令微调（使用四个英/中文医疗LoRA的Qwen2-7B-Instruct）等任务上始终优于现有的合并方法。

articles.title: Multi-level Encoder with Global Topic for Task-oriented Dialogue Summarization
articles.abstract: Task-oriented dialogue summarization aims to automatically extract key information to generate domain summaries to improve service efficiency and quality. Task-oriented dialogue is inherently logical and surrounds specific topic. How to effectively capture the dialogue topic and the most salient information becomes one of the major challenges of this task. In this paper, we propose a task-oriented dialogue summarization model utilizing a multi-level encoder with global topic (MLEGT). This model discovers temporal and spatial dependencies through a multi-level encoder, while simultaneously obtaining a simple yet effective global topic in the process of graph construction. It not only captures the crucial details but also breaks the long-range limit and discover the intrinsic structure across the dialogue. Then, a global topic guided pointer mechanism is added into the summrizer to capture ignored but important information, which is helpful to improve the accuracy of the summary. A comprehensive study of two public datasets, including a real-world large-scale Chinese police interrogation dataset and a medical reporting service dataset proves the superiority of our method on several strong baselines.
articles.titleCn: 面向任务型对话摘要的多层编码器与全局主题
articles.abstractCn: 面向任务的对话摘要旨在自动提取关键信息以生成领域摘要，从而提高服务效率和质量。面向任务的对话本质上具有逻辑性，并围绕特定主题。如何有效捕捉对话主题和最显著信息成为该任务的主要挑战之一。在本文中，我们提出了一种利用多级编码器与全局主题（MLEGT）的面向任务的对话摘要模型。该模型通过多级编码器发现时间和空间依赖关系，同时在图构建过程中同时获得简单而有效的全局主题。它不仅捕捉了关键细节，还打破了长程限制，发现了对话的内在结构。然后，在摘要生成器中添加了全局主题引导的指针机制，以捕捉被忽略但重要的信息，这有助于提高摘要的准确性。对两个公共数据集的综合研究，包括一个真实世界的大规模中文警察审讯数据集和医疗报告服务数据集，证明了我们的方法在多个强基线上的优越性。

articles.title: Same Answer, Different Reasons: Trace-Level Divergence in Multilingual Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Multilingual large language models are increasingly deployed in settings where visible reasoning traces support verification, education, and safety auditing, yet standard evaluations typically measure only final-answer agreement or holistic response similarity. As a result, they establish outcome consistency without determining whether users across languages receive comparable supporting evidence. We introduce a trace-level divergence framework that compares visible reasoning traces as structured sequences, decomposing agreement into structural similarity, order consistency, and holistic similarity, with pair-specific calibration to enable comparison across languages. Across three reasoning benchmarks, seven languages, and six frontier LLMs, the natural baseline---embedding each whole response and comparing the two by cosine---systematically overstates agreement: $52.1\%$--$67.3\%$ of examples in the top quartile of holistic similarity are not in the top quartile of structural similarity. This dissociation is stable across sentence encoders and step segmentations, and blind bilingual annotation studies in two English-anchored language pairs show that human judgments align with structural similarity rather than with the holistic baseline. A same-language control shows that the level of divergence is language-specific: two English traces for paraphrases of the same question agree more closely than an English trace and its counterparts in other languages. Our results show that answer-level and holistic evaluations can substantially overestimate the consistency of multilingual explanatory artifacts, motivating trace-level evaluation for reliable multilingual deployment.
articles.titleCn: 相同答案，不同原因：多语言大型语言模型的微观级分歧
articles.abstractCn: 多语言大语言模型越来越多地应用于支持验证、教育和安全审计的可见推理轨迹环境中，然而标准评估通常仅测量最终答案的一致性或整体响应的相似性。因此，它们建立了结果一致性，却未能确定不同语言的用户是否获得了可比的支持证据。我们引入了一种轨迹级差异框架，将可见推理轨迹作为结构化序列进行比较，将一致性分解为结构相似性、顺序一致性和整体相似性，并通过特定配对的校准实现跨语言比较。在三个推理基准、七种语言和六种前沿LLM中，自然基线——将每个完整响应嵌入并使用余弦相似度进行比较——系统性地高估了一致性：在整体相似性排名前四分之一中的52.1%--67.3%的示例并不在结构相似性排名前四分之一中。这种分离在不同句子编码器和步骤分割中都保持稳定，并且对两种以英语为基准的语言对进行的盲法双语标注研究表明，人类判断与结构相似性而非整体基线一致。同语言对照实验表明，差异程度具有语言特异性：同一问题的两个英语轨迹比英语轨迹及其在其他语言中的对应轨迹更为相似。我们的结果表明，答案级和整体评估可能大幅高估多语言解释性工件的连贯性，从而推动了对可靠多语言部署的轨迹级评估。

articles.title: A Large-Scale Evaluation of Role-Enhanced Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought Prompting
articles.abstract: This paper proposes Role-Enhanced Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought (RE-ZS-CoT), a prompting framework that systematically integrates domain-specific expert roles to enhance reasoning in large language models (LLMs) without task-specific examples. We assess two versions of our approach. In the first version, static role selection, we evaluate eight predefined expert roles across arithmetic, commonsense, and reading comprehension benchmarks to determine their impact on reasoning performance. In the second version, dynamic role selection, each model autonomously selects the single most suitable role for each benchmark, enabling adaptive task-role alignment without manual specification. Across 20 LLMs and seven benchmarks, RE-ZS-CoT frequently surpasses zero-shot and zero-shot-CoT baselines, achieving performance improvements of up to 44 percentage points. The results reveal a strong correspondence between static and dynamic versions; the benchmarks where static roles yielded improvements were almost always those where dynamic roles also outperformed baselines, though static selection achieved peak performance. Ablation studies further show that unconventional roles degrade performance, underscoring the necessity of task-role alignment. The framework's scalability is validated across model sizes (2b-14b parameters), with smaller models like Granite3.3-8b achieving remarkable proficiency in arithmetic reasoning. RE-ZS-CoT advances zero-shot prompting by unifying role specialization with chain-of-thought reasoning, offering a practical, resource-efficient solution for improving LLM capabilities across diverse domains.
articles.titleCn: 大规模角色增强零样本思维链提示评估
articles.abstractCn: 本文提出了角色增强零样本思维链（RE-ZS-CoT），这是一种提示框架，通过系统地整合特定领域的专家角色，在不使用特定任务示例的情况下增强大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。我们评估了我们的方法的两个版本。在第一个版本中，静态角色选择，我们在算术、常识和阅读理解基准测试中评估了八个预定义的专家角色，以确定它们对推理性能的影响。在第二个版本中，动态角色选择，每个模型自主地为每个基准测试选择最合适的单个角色，从而实现自适应的任务角色匹配，无需手动指定。在20个LLM和7个基准测试中，RE-ZS-CoT经常超越零样本和零样本-CoT基线，性能提升高达44个百分点。结果表明静态版本和动态版本之间存在强对应关系；静态角色产生改进的基准测试几乎总是那些动态角色也优于基线的测试，尽管静态选择达到了峰值性能。消融研究进一步表明，非常规角色会降低性能，突出了任务角色匹配的必要性。该框架的可扩展性在模型大小（2b-14b参数）上得到验证，较小的模型如Granite3.3-8b在算术推理方面表现出色。RE-ZS-CoT通过统一角色专业化和思维链推理，推动了零样本提示的发展，为提高LLM在不同领域的能力提供了一种实用、资源高效的解决方案。

articles.title: Our Own Jev: Typed Decisions in One Forward Pass, from an In-House Judge to Open LoRA Models
articles.abstract: A typed decision maps evidence, a question and a fixed set of options to a probability for every option, computed in one forward pass, by reading a language model's logits or a small head over its hidden states, instead of generating and parsing text. The commercial system Jev popularised this System~1 interface, and open reproductions have followed. We report two uses of the pattern. \emph{Part I} describes an in-house System~1 judge that triages about 148K agentic coding session records for a training corpus. It replaces a frontier LLM judge that cost on the order of \$1,000 per pass and whose stored labels matched a fresh two-judge consensus on only 26.9\% of the sessions where the two judges agreed; a self-hosted frozen backbone with a rank-16 LoRA adapter and a pointer head answers three typed questions in one forward pass, judges 1,000 sessions in about three minutes of one GPU, about \$0.06 at a reference rate and roughly 1\% of the frontier judge's cost, and keeps every session inside the organisation. \emph{Part II} asks whether a readout that adds no parameters can be competitive and whether training one helps. Applying the public Eikos recipe and corpus of about 25K decisions to three further backbones (1B, 2B and 35B), we read the frozen output layer of a LoRA-adapted decoder. On the 111 public hard items of JevBench our single-seed 35B, developed with those items in view, scores 79.3\%, not significantly different from the commercial reference (73.0\%, unadjusted $p=0.12$) and ahead of five open systems after Holm--Bonferroni correction; our 2B is ahead of all four kev checkpoints on the leaderboard. A single-seed ablation finds no detectable benefit from training the 26 letter rows of the output layer, and a retrain on a later corpus release moves the 2B's hard-tier accuracy by 11.7 points, which shows how little small evaluations resolve.
articles.titleCn: 我们自己的杰夫：单次前向传递中的类型化决策，从内部法官到开源LoRA模型
articles.abstractCn: 一个类型化的决策将证据、问题和一个固定的选项集映射到每个选项的概率，通过一次性正向传递，读取语言模型的logits或其隐藏状态上的一个小头部，而不是生成和解析文本来计算。商业系统Jev推广了这个System~1界面，公开的复制品也随之出现。我们报告了该模式的两种用途。 \emph{第一部分}描述了一个内部System~1裁判，用于对约148K个代理编码会话记录进行分拣，用于训练语料库。它取代了一个前沿LLM裁判，该裁判每次传递的成本约为1000美元，其存储的标签仅在两个裁判一致的26.9%的会话中与新鲜的两裁判共识匹配；一个自托管冻结的骨干网络，带有秩为16的LoRA适配器和指针头部，在一次正向传递中回答三个类型化问题，在一个GPU上约三分钟内裁判1000个会话，参考费率约为0.06美元，成本约为前沿裁判的1%，并将每个会话保留在组织内部。 \emph{第二部分}探讨了是否可以竞争一个不增加参数的读出，以及是否有助于进行训练。应用公开的Eikos配方和约25K个决策的语料库，应用于三个进一步的骨干网络（1B、2B和35B），我们读取了经过LoRA适配的解码器的冻结输出层。在JevBench的111个公共难题上，我们用这些难题开发的单种子35B，得分率为79.3%，与商业参考（73.0%，未调整$p=0.12$）没有显著差异，并在Holm--Bonferroni校正后领先于五个公开系统；我们的2B领先于排行榜上的所有四个kev检查点。单种子消融实验发现，训练输出层的26个字母行没有可检测到的益处，而在稍后的语料库发布上重新训练，将2B的难题层准确率提高了11.7分，这表明小型评估能解决的问题有多少。

articles.title: Target Regeneration Shrinks the Gains of Draft-Training Objectives in Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language models by verifying drafted tokens in parallel. New draft-training objectives are usually credited with the acceptance they add over cross-entropy on externally written responses, yet many pipelines let the target rewrite them. We ask how much of that gain survives. With a vision-language target and a block drafter, we train three objectives on four versions of one corpus: cross-entropy on corpus tokens, token-level distillation from the target, and distillation gated to positions that would survive verification. Distillation and the gate add large gains on external responses, but after greedy regeneration, distillation adds a smaller gain and the gate little or none. The shrinkage persists across data orders, position weights, verifiers, decoding temperatures and, for distillation, initializations and learning rates. Most of it remains at matched supervised length and at each objective's best measured training length. A second vision corpus shows the shrinkage, as does a text-only replication, for distillation also with an autoregressive drafter. Objective gains should therefore be measured against a target-regenerated baseline and across training lengths. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/TargetRegeneration.
articles.titleCn: 目标再生会缩小推测解码中草稿训练目标的收益
articles.abstractCn: 推测解码通过并行验证草拟的标记来加速大型语言模型。新的草拟训练目标通常因其在外部编写响应上相对于交叉熵所增加的接受度而受到认可，但许多流程允许目标重新编写它们。我们探究了其中多少收益得以保留。我们使用一个视觉语言目标和一个块状草拟器，在语料库的四个版本上训练了三个目标：语料库标记的交叉熵、从目标中蒸馏的标记级蒸馏，以及蒸馏到会通过验证的位置进行门控。蒸馏和门控在外部响应上增加了巨大的收益，但在贪婪再生后，蒸馏增加的收益较小，门控几乎没有或完全没有。这种收益缩减在数据顺序、位置权重、验证器、解码温度以及对于蒸馏的初始化和学习率上持续存在。大部分收益在匹配的监督长度和每个目标最佳测量的训练长度上仍然存在。第二个视觉语料库也显示了收益缩减，一个纯文本复制也显示了这一点，对于蒸馏还使用了自回归草拟器。因此，目标收益应与目标再生基线以及跨训练长度进行衡量。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/js-lee-AI/TargetRegeneration 获取。

articles.title: VeriEvolve: Evaluator-First Evolution for Tool-Using Agents
articles.abstract: A central obstacle to self-improving agents is the absence of a reliable fitness signal for realistic stateful tasks. We introduce \textsc{VeriEvolve}, an evaluator-first evolution framework that constructs this missing evaluation layer before optimizing the agent. From task instruction, VeriEvolve synthesizes instruction-grounded challenge states and an executable evaluator that checks them. During each round of workflow evolution, the evaluator is frozen and serves as the fitness signal. Between rounds, VeriEvolve revises the evaluator by converting the end states of strong and weak runs into a pair of counterfactual test cases. Across all 30 MCPMark Filesystem tasks, VeriEvolve constructs 30 evaluators with 141 challenge states, achieving 141/141 agreement on the generated suites and 113/122 agreement on held-out states produced by executor agents. Evaluator-guided evolution increases externally verified success from 6/30 to 18/30 for GLM-5.2 and from 27/30 to 30/30 for Claude; refinement removes all three false positives that the weak executor exposes. Cross-environment studies on PostgreSQL, Playwright, Notion, and GitHub further expose complementary limits from observability, state representation, and search/execution capacity. These results show that executable evaluators can be synthesized and used to guide search when task success is observable and an external verifier is available for calibration.

articles.titleCn: VeriEvolve：面向使用工具的智能体的先评估者进化
articles.abstractCn: 自我改进智能体面临的一个核心障碍是缺乏针对现实状态任务的可靠适应度信号。我们引入了\textsc{VeriEvolve}，这是一个以评估器优先的进化框架，它在优化智能体之前构建了缺失的评估层。从任务指令出发，VeriEvolve合成基于指令的挑战状态和可执行的评估器来检查这些状态。在每个工作流进化的轮次中，评估器被冻结并作为适应度信号。在轮次之间，VeriEvolve通过将强运行和弱运行的最后状态转换为一对反事实测试用例来修订评估器。在所有30个MCPMark文件系统任务中，VeriEvolve构建了30个评估器，包含141个挑战状态，生成的套件在141/141上达成一致，执行器智能体产生的保留状态在113/122上达成一致。评估器引导的进化将GLM-5.2的外部验证成功率从6/30提高到18/30，将Claude的成功率从27/30提高到30/30；精炼消除了弱执行器暴露的所有三个误报。在PostgreSQL、Playwright、Notion和GitHub上的跨环境研究进一步揭示了可观察性、状态表示和搜索/执行能力方面的互补限制。这些结果表明，当任务成功可观察且存在外部验证器进行校准时，可执行评估器可以被合成并用于指导搜索。
